title: Senior Embryologist for a Private Fertility Clinic in Aarhus
description:
Would you like to work as an embryologist at a private fertility clinic in Aarhus, where you will have supportive colleagues, sufficient time to perform your work and a high degree of influence?

We are looking for a skilled embryologist to join our clinic in Aarhus. You will become part of a multidisciplinary team united by a shared passion for making a difference to our patients.

About the position

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. Sellmer Klinik Aarhus is owned by Anette Sellmer, who forms the clinic's management team together with Clinic Manager Bodil Meldgaard. Our management is visible and committed and delegates responsibility to employees who thrive on it.

We place our patients and a positive working environment at the heart of everything we do. This means, among other things, that you will have sufficient time to carry out your duties properly and will be expected to take an active part in developing and implementing new ideas.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

IVF and ICSI

Embryo transfer

Thawing and cryopreservation of oocytes and blastocysts

AHA

Sperm preparation and cryopreservation

Assessment of oocytes

Administrative duties, including tasks related to the export of tissues and cells

Your colleagues

We have an excellent working environment and work very well together across professional disciplines. We respect and make use of each other's expertise while keeping up with developments in the field and continuously improving our overall professional standards.

We also have a strong social community. We eat lunch together every day, enjoy spending time together and occasionally meet outside working hours. We value our positive working environment highly and make a genuine effort to protect it. It is therefore important to us that our new colleague feels at home and fits well within the team.

About you

You are a qualified embryologist.

You have experience within fertility treatment.

You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues on patient-related tasks while also being comfortable working independently.

You speak and write Danish and English.

You are able to work 28-37 hours per week, including weekends and public holidays as part of a fixed rota.

We offer

A workplace with strong collegial support and professional sparring as part of a close multidisciplinary team. You can expect:

Sufficient time to carry out your daily duties and a high degree of influence

Opportunities for professional and personal development

Friendly and positive colleagues

An organisation with a short path from decision to action

The terms of employment will depend on your experience and qualifications. Employment is conditional upon your consent to the clinic obtaining a satisfactory child protection certificate and upon holding the required professional authorisation.

For further information about the position, please contact Bodil Meldgaard at bodil@sellmerklinik.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Adjunkt eller lektor til Center for Pædagogik
description:
Vil du være med til at give vores studerende og kursister nogle stærke faglige forudsætninger for at arbejde professionelt og i praksis med det pædagogiske fagområde?

Center for Pædagogik i Roskilde søger en adjunkt eller lektor til en fast stilling med henblik på at planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisning på pædagoguddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Vi søger en underviser, som kan styrke centerets kompetencer indenfor e-læring og digitale læringsformer. Det er et centralt krav, at du har erfaring med udvikling og gennemførelse af digitale læringsforløb. Derudover skal du kunne undervise på tværs af pædagoguddannelsens tre specialiseringer: dagtilbud, skole/fritid samt social- og specialpædagogik.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition at levere engagerende undervisning. Det er en del af vores uddannelsesløfte til de studerende, at du skal facilitere undervisning af høj kvalitet og samtidig brænde for at skabe læring og motivere de studerende. Det er vigtigt, at de studerende kan mærke deres uddannelse fra første dag. Det bidrager til en særlig uddannelseskultur, hvor du som underviser understøtter et fællesskab mellem de studerende, der bidrager til en samlet organisation, sætter de studerende først og har en stærk uddannelsesprofessionalisme.

Din profil
Du får en vigtig funktion i forhold til at undervise både på grunduddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Det er derfor væsentligt, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Særlige faglige kompetencer. Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du har solid erfaring med at udvikle, tilrettelægge og gennemføre e-læring og digitale læringsforløb samt dokumenterede kompetencer inden for digitale læringsdesigns, og digitale undervisnings- og vejledningsformer. Samtidig har du bred pædagogfaglig indsigt og har faglige forudsætninger for at undervise på tværs af pædagoguddannelsens tre specialiseringer: dagtilbud, skole/fritid samt social- og specialpædagogik. Vi ser gerne, at du kan dokumentere dine kompetencer gennem tidligere undervisnings-, udviklings- eller uddannelsesopgaver.

Praksiserfaring. Du har erfaring med at arbejde i pædagogiske praksisfelter indenfor dagtilbud, skole/fritid, social- og specialpædagogiske tilbud eller lignende. Du kan let supplere teoretisk stof med praksiseksempler, og du har flair for at inddrage de studerendes erfaringer som en naturlig del af undervisningen.

Didaktisk erfaring og kompetencer. Du står stærkt i mødet med studerende, hvor din undervisning bærer præg af variation, nærvær og engagement. Du kan facilitere og lede læreprocesser, og din undervisning bærer præg af at være varieret, nærværende og engagerende. Din tilgang til undervisningen er kendetegnet ved en ambition om inddragelse samt et højt fagligt niveau med øje for at skabe forskellige deltagelsesmuligheder for de studerende.

Stærke samarbejdsevner. Du er interesseret i at være en del af et læringsfællesskab, hvor undervisningen udvikles sammen med dine kolleger, og hvor faglig sparring er en fast bestanddel af hverdagen.

Fokus på kerneopgaven og gode studiemiljøer. Du har en høj faglighed, og du ser kerneopgaven som omdrejningspunktet for prioriteringen af dine arbejdsopgaver. Du kan derudover se dig selv bidrage til Absalons uddannelsesløfte, hvilket blandt andet indebærer at skabe inkluderende studiemiljøer.

Derudover forventer vi os, at:
  • du har en master-, kandidatuddannelse eller ph.d. relateret til det pædagogiske fagområde og/eller det social- og specialpædagogiske fagområde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser i Center for Pædagogik foregår dit arbejde inden for tre områder:

Grunduddannelsen. Du indgår i et team, der tilrettelægger og evaluerer undervisning og samarbejder om at udvikle kvaliteten i de moduler, du skal undervise på. Du kommer også til at arbejde på tværs af teams i forbindelse med overleveringer mellem moduler.

Efter- og videreuddannelsen. Du bliver en del af forskellige samarbejdskonstellationer omkring planlægning og gennemførelse af efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Du skal forvente at undervise flere forskellige steder i og uden for regionen og på Absalons andre lokationer. Det er derfor en fordel, at du har egen bil.

Forskning og udvikling. Du skal forvente at deltage i praksisnære og innovative forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter.

Du må forvente, at der i begrænset omfang kan forekomme undervisning til kl. 18.00 og om lørdagen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Center for Pædagogik med omkring 140 medarbejdere fordelt på fem af Absalons campusser. Din primære arbejdsplads vil være på Campus Roskilde, der ligger i gåafstand fra Trekroner Station.

På pædagoguddannelsen i Roskilde er vi en dynamisk arbejdsplads med ca. 60 dygtige medarbejdere. Hver eneste dag arbejder vi sammen om at uddanne fremtidens pædagoger og gøre nuværende fagprofessionelle og ledere dygtigere.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.994, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.938 kr. inkl. pension. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. december 2026.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Jacob Guldager Søe på tlf. 7248 1482 eller uddannelsesleder Thue Friislund på tlf. 72 48 1486.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem herhttps://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest mandag den 19. oktober klokken 12.00.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 23. oktober og 2. samtaler den 26. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer vil du blive ansat som adjunkt eller lektor På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Tekniker / montør med flytteopgaver søges – deltid eller fuldtid
description:
Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS

På grund af stigende aktivitet søger vi en dygtig og praktisk anlagt tekniker/montør, som har lyst til en alsidig hverdag med montage, demontering, tekniske opgaver og specialtransport.

Vores primære behov er en medarbejder til montage- og teknikeropgaver. Der vil også forekomme almindelige flytteopgaver, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at hjælpe til med flytning og fysisk arbejde, når opgaverne kræver det.

Stillingen kan være deltid eller fuldtid, afhængigt af dine ønsker, erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Montering og demontering af fitnessudstyr og træningsmaskiner

  • Samling, opstilling og justering af maskiner og teknisk udstyr

  • Nedtagning og klargøring af udstyr til transport

  • Indbæring og placering af maskiner og specialudstyr

  • Brug af almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Praktiske og tekniske opgaver hos vores erhvervskunder

  • Specialtransport og håndtering af tungt eller teknisk udstyr

  • Fejlfinding og mindre tekniske opgaver, hvor det er relevant

  • Flytteopgaver for private og erhvervskunder efter behov

  • Andre praktiske montage- og specialopgaver

Vi arbejder med mange forskellige typer opgaver og udstyr. Det kan eksempelvis være fitnessmaskiner, teknisk udstyr, maskiner, pengeskabe, klaverer, flygler og andet specialinventar.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er praktisk anlagt og har god teknisk forståelse

  • Har erfaring med montage, teknik, mekanik eller lignende – eller stor interesse for området

  • Kan bruge almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Kan finde løsninger, når en opgave ikke altid går helt efter planen

  • Er omhyggelig og passer godt på kundernes maskiner og udstyr

  • Har god fysik og kan deltage i flytte- og løfteopgaver

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sammen med kollegaer

  • Er serviceminded og kan kommunikere professionelt med vores kunder

  • Har kørekort B

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring som montør, servicetekniker, mekaniker eller lignende

  • Erfaring med fitnessmaskiner eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Erfaring med flyttearbejde eller specialtransport

  • Kørekort C

  • Varebilschaufføruddannelsesbevis

Det er dog ikke et krav, at du kommer fra flyttebranchen.

Vi vægter teknisk forståelse, praktiske evner og den rette indstilling højt.

Vi tilbyder

  • Deltids- eller fuldtidsstilling

  • En alsidig arbejdsdag med hovedvægt på montage og tekniske opgaver

  • Oplæring i vores forskellige typer specialopgaver

  • Arbejde med mange forskellige maskiner og typer udstyr

  • Opgaver hos både mindre og større erhvervskunder

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for montage, teknik og specialtransport

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel arbejdsplads

  • Ordentlige arbejdsforhold

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi leder først og fremmest efter en tekniker/montør – ikke kun en traditionel flyttemand.

Du skal kunne lide at arbejde med hænderne, bruge værktøj og finde praktiske løsninger. Samtidig skal du være indstillet på, at vi er en flytte- og transportvirksomhed, og at der derfor også vil være dage, hvor du hjælper med almindelige flytteopgaver.

Hos Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS er dagene forskellige. Den ene dag kan du demontere og montere fitnessmaskiner, og den næste dag kan du være med til at flytte og opstille tungt specialudstyr hos en erhvervskunde.

Kan du skrue, samle, montere og finde praktiske løsninger – og er du samtidig klar til at tage fat – så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og CV til buchtrup2016@gmail.com.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på 86 15 72 60, hvis du vil høre mere om jobbet.

Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS

Arbejdstid: Deltid eller fuldtid
Kørekort: B (almindelig bil) – kørekort C er en fordel

title: Chief Commercial Officer
description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

  • Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

  • Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

  • Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

  • Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

  • Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

  • Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

  • Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

  • Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

  • A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

  • Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

  • Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

  • Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

  • Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

  • Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

  • A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

  • Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

  • Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

title: Forskningsprojekt Arven i Landskabet
description:
Museum Odense søger en postdoc til en etårig stilling i forskningsprojektet Arven i Landskabet.

Forskningsprojektet

Det danske landskab står over for nogle af de største forandringer i nyere tid. Med Den Grønne Trepart og en række andre natur-, klima- og miljøtiltag skal store arealer i de kommende år ændre anvendelse. Landbrug, natur, biodiversitet, klima og lokale interesser skal finde nye balancer. Men det er ikke første gang, det danske landskab gennemgår en grundlæggende omstilling.

Arven i Landskabet undersøger det store brud i det danske landskabs udvikling ca. 1780-1914. I løbet af denne periode blev et varieret og mange steder ekstensivt udnyttet kulturlandskab forandret til et stadig mere intensivt landbrugslandskab. Gennem analyser af blandt andet historiske kort, nationale data og lokale kilder undersøger projektet, hvad der drev forandringerne, hvordan de udspillede sig forskelligt fra sted til sted, og hvilken betydning landskabets fysiske rammer, teknologiske muligheder, økonomiske interesser og menneskers valg havde.

Projektet stopper imidlertid ikke i 1914. Et centralt mål er at bringe den historiske viden i spil i den aktuelle grønne omstilling. Hvad kan tidligere tiders gennemgribende landskabsforandringer fortælle os om de processer, konflikter og muligheder, der præger omstillingen i dag? Og hvordan kan et langt historisk perspektiv kvalificere vores forståelse af de valg, der nu træffes om fremtidens landskab?

Projektet er støttet af Augustinus Fonden 2026-2029 og placeret på Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum. Din arbejdsplads bliver på Museum Odense. Læs mere på https://museumodense.dk/forskningsartikler/arven-i-landskabet/.

Stillingen

Som postdoc får du en central rolle i den del af Arven i Landskabet, der forbinder projektets historiske undersøgelser med de landskabsforandringer, der finder sted i Danmark netop nu.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at undersøge, hvordan nutidens landmænd, lodsejere og andre lokale aktører oplever og forholder sig til den grønne omstilling og til konkrete forandringer i det landskab, de lever og arbejder i. Det gælder blandt andet processer og naturprojekter knyttet til Den Grønne Trepart. Gennem kvalitative interviews og, hvor det er relevant, surveys og andre analyser skal du undersøge aktørernes perspektiver, handlemuligheder og interesser samt de muligheder og konflikter, der opstår, når hensyn til landbrugsproduktion, klima, biodiversitet, natur og lokalsamfund mødes.

Undersøgelserne skal sættes i relation til projektets historiske forskning. Du kommer dermed til at arbejde med spørgsmål som: Hvordan gennemføres store landskabsforandringer lokalt? Hvad får mennesker til at medvirke til, modsætte sig eller forsøge at påvirke dem? Hvilken betydning har erfaringer, ejerskab, økonomi, natursyn og tilknytning til landskabet? Og hvad kan erfaringerne fra tidligere perioder med omfattende landskabsforandringer bidrage med til de beslutninger, vi træffer i dag?

Opgaven har således en klar ramme, men der er samtidig betydeligt forskningsmæssigt råderum. Afhængigt af din faglige profil og dine interesser får du mulighed for at præge undersøgelsens forskningsspørgsmål, teoretiske perspektiv, metode og konkrete empiriske fokus inden for projektets overordnede problemstillinger.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig forskningsgruppe på tværs af Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum og vil arbejde tæt sammen med projektets øvrige forskere. Stillingen indebærer både selvstændigt forskningsarbejde og deltagelse i projektets fælles aktiviteter. Du forventes blandt andet at bidrage til projektets dataindsamling og analyser, videnskabelige publikationer, den afsluttende antologi og et fagligt symposium samt til formidling af forskningen til en bredere offentlighed og den aktuelle debat om fremtidens landskab.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en ph.d.-grad eller tilsvarende inden for f.eks. etnologi, antropologi, historie eller tilsvarende relevante fag.
  • Har erfaring med interviews til forskningsundersøgelser.
  • Har interesse for landskabsforskning og -forvaltning.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har kørekort B, da der kan forventes kørsel i arbejdstiden. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et tværfagligt og spændende forskningsmiljø, heriblandt fire andre forskere ved Arven i Landskabet i Odense.
  • Deltagelse i den større tværfaglige projektgruppe med forskere på Aarhus Universitet, Det Grønne Museum og Museum Odense (heriblandt Den Fynske Landsby).
  • En kombination af klart definerede projektopgaver og forskningsmæssigt råderum til at udvikle egne spørgsmål og analyser inden for projektets ramme.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

  • En motiveret ansøgning (maks. 2 sider), hvor du redegør for:
    • din motivation for at søge stillingen
    • dine kvalifikationer i forhold til opslaget
    • en kort beskrivelse af, hvordan du vil tilgå projektet forskningsmæssigt
  • CV (maks. 2 sider)
  • En kopi af kandidatbevis og evt. ph.d.-bevis
  • Publikationsliste med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, som ønskes taget i betragtning ved bedømmelsen
  • Maksimalt 2 vedhæftede publikationer til bedømmelse.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. nov. 2026

Vi anvender shortlisting, hvor et antal ansøgere udvælges til bedømmelse af deres faglige kvalifikationer. På baggrund af bedømmelserne indkaldes en eller flere kandidater til samtale. De ansøgere, hvis ansøgning ikke sendes til bedømmelse, orienteres om dette umiddelbart efter shortlisting. Samtaler foretages i midten af december. Endeligt afslag sendes ved afslutningen af rekrutteringen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende forhandlingsberettigede overenskomst. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i 12 måneder. Det primære arbejdssted er Forskningscenter CENTRUM ved Museum Odense og det forventes, at du som udgangspunkt er til stede på museet i arbejdstiden. Der vil dog forekomme feltarbejde, seminarer og projektmøder andre steder.

Tiltrædelse 1. feb. 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Uddybende spørgsmål om stillingen kan rettes til projektleder ved Arven i Landskabet Peder Dam tlf. 21493464 og mail pda@museumodense.dk.

Museum Odense er en selvejende institution og et af landets store statsanerkendte kulturhistoriske museer. Vi driver i alt seks museer og havde i 2025 et samlet besøgstal på over 400.000. Museets Vision 2026 og Strategi 2024-2026 sætter rammer og retning for museets ambitiøse udvikling i de kommende år. Se museets vision og strategi på Organisation - Museum Odense Museum-Odense_kort-strategi-2024-2026.pdf

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

  • Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

    • Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

    • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

    • Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

    • Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement

    • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

    • Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

  •   Technical leadership

    • Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

  • Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

    • With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

    • Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

      • Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

      • Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

      • Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

    • Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

    • Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

    • Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

    • Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

  • Technical Expertise

    • Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

    • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

    • Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

    • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

    • Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

  • Management & Interpersonal Skills

    • High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

    • Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

    • Contractor control

    • Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

  • Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

  • Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

  • Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

  • A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

  • Good safety attitude

  • Can do attitude

title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og CV til smag@smag-toscana.dk

Ansøgning mærkes i emnefeltet: Restaurationsmanager

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will appoint the right candidate as soon as they are found.

We look forward to hearing from you

title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

title: (Senior) Solution Architect
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Do you want to design and evolve modern organisation-wide architecture that enables investments, from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to take a pivotal role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A leading role in shaping our holistic organisation‑wide solution architecture

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices and unite 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is expanding to 26 professionals, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join a team of experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

You shape our digital backbone and architectural direction

We are looking for an Solution Architect, to take the lead in designing, maintaining, and governing the company wide architecture that underpins our global impact. You ensure coherence across platforms, promote future‑ready solutions, and translate business needs into secure, scalable, and well‑governed technologies. Along the way, you will work closely with our subject matter experts, and various business stakeholders.

You will, for example:

  • Design and maintain the end‑to‑end organisation-wide architecture for our technology stack, which includes Dynamics 365 CE and F&O, Power Platform, Fabric, Copilot and related SaaS systems.

  • Co-own and enforce best practices for deployment, release management, and technical documentation

  • Define and create Architecture Principles for our entire technology stack e.g. integration principles and patterns that govern how applications and data interconnect

  • Drive a forward‑looking technology perspective, monitoring trends and identifying improvements

  • Drive technology selection to evaluate and assess new applications or technology requests to improve our internal value generation and efficiency.

You bring technical insights and architectural understanding

With your background in architectural areas like, Solution Architecture, application/system architecture, Software Architecture or transferable roles), you understand how to turn technical complexity into structured, long-term solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

  • Have strong experience with solution architecture and how applications and platforms integrate

  • Understand IT governance, data protection, and compliance

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector

Our current technology stack is among others based:

  • Dynamics CE

  • Dynamics F&O

  • M365

  • Microsoft Fabric

  • Microsoft Dataverse

  • and several fit for purpose SaaS solutions/applications

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets.
