title: Directeur Régional Hôtellerie (H/F)
description:
Description du poste :

Piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels, développer le business et faire rayonner la destination Lille.

Un cluster hôtelier ne se développe pas uniquement grâce à la force de ses marques.


Il grandit grâce à une stratégie commerciale claire, des équipes engagées, une lecture fine du marché et une capacité à transformer chaque opportunité en performance.


Au sein de WiZiU, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur Commercial Lille NB/F/H pour piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels multi enseignes , développer directement l'activité sur le marché lillois et accompagner les équipes dans leurs ambitions commerciales Ce que tu vas faire (et faire vivre au quotidien)

Tu définis et pilotes la stratégie commerciale du cluster en tenant compte des différents segments de marché, de la saisonnalité et des spécificités de chaque enseigne.


Tu contribues à la construction budgétaire et au suivi des projections de chiffre d'affaires, tout en accompagnant les évolutions stratégiques du portefeuille.


Tu restes également très présent(e) sur le terrain : prospection, rendez-vous clients, négociation, closing et développement d'un portefeuille Corporate, MICE et Groupes sur la place lilloise.


Tu pilotes directement le Group Desk , la Responsable Coordination Événementielle et l' Attachée Commerciale , et travailles en coordination étroite avec les Sales Manager/Commerciaux externes.


Tu fixes les priorités, accompagnes la performance de l'équipe et t'assures de la qualité du suivi commercial, des délais de réponse et de la conversion des opportunités.


Tu travailles au quotidien avec le Revenue Management pour partager le pipeline, arbitrer les opportunités et aligner stratégie commerciale et optimisation du revenu. Tu collabores également directement avec le Marketing pour activer les bons leviers sur le F&B, la visibilité digitale et les campagnes B2B.


Enfin, tu représentes WiZiU et ses hôtels auprès de l'écosystème économique et touristique lillois : acteurs institutionnels, réseaux d'entreprises, organisations professionnelles et partenaires de la destination Toi, tu es.

Tu as une expérience confirmée en direction commerciale hôtelière , idéalement sur un environnement multi-sites ou multi-marques.


Tu es avant tout un(e) commercial(e) de terrain : tu aimes prospecter, négocier, développer un réseau et closer.


Tu sais aussi prendre de la hauteur, construire une stratégie et accompagner une équipe dans sa performance.


Tu maîtrises les enjeux MICE, Groupes et Corporate , tu comprends les logiques de Revenue Management et tu sais travailler de manière fluide avec les équipes Marketing.


Tu es autonome, structuré(e), orienté(e) résultats et capable de passer naturellement d'un sujet stratégique à une problématique très opérationnelle.


Tu es à l'aise en anglais et tu as envie de prendre une place active dans l'écosystème économique lillois Pourquoi nous rejoindre.

Pour prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'un cluster de 8 hôtels aux enseignes fortes et complémentaires Pour occuper un rôle qui combine réellement stratégie, management et vente directe Pour travailler au cœur d'un environnement en transformation, avec des projets de repositionnement et d'évolution de marques.


Pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes Commerciales, Revenue, Marketing, Direction et Opérationnelles du Groupe.


Et surtout, pour avoir un impact direct sur le développement de WiZiU et de ses hôtels sur la place lilloise Tes avantages

- Bénéficiez d'une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 60 Profitez du bénéfice des jours fériés dès 6 mois d'ancienneté chez WiZiU.
- Recevez une prime WiZconnect grâce à vos recommandations.
- Recevez la prime WiZtrust pour récompenser votre fidélité.
- Profitez de possibilités d'évolution au sein du Groupe.
- Bénéficiez du programme WiZdiscount avec des remises exclusives dans les hôtels, restaurants et SPA du Groupe WiZiU.


Chez WiZiU, chaque stratégie, chaque relation client et chaque opportunité transformée participent au développement de nos hôtels.


Derrière la performance d'un cluster, il y a aussi un(e) Directeur Commercial(e) capable de donner une direction, d'embarquer les équipes et de rester connecté(e) au terrain Salaire : 65 à 70K€ annuel + 15% variable.


Poste Cadre basé à Lille.

title: Ingénieur de production DEVOPS (H/F)

description:
Ingénieur DevOps Cloud / Kubernetes (H/F)
1. Contexte du Poste & Enjeux à Toulouse
Expérience requise : 9 ans minimum (profil Senior / Expert).
Localisation : Toulouse et agglomération (Blagnac, Labège, etc.).

Contexte local :
Missions Principales
Architecture & Design de Plateformes Cloud : Concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les architectures Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP ou Cloud Souverain) et on-premise hautement disponibles, scalables et sécurisées.
Stratégie Kubernetes & Containerisation : Définir la stratégie de conteneurisation globale de l'entreprise, industrialiser le déploiement des clusters Kubernetes à grande échelle et garantir leur résilience.
Industrialisation & Automatisation (CI/CD) : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) les plus optimisés possibles pour automatiser le cycle de vie applicatif du code à la production.
FinOps & Performance : Optimiser les coûts d'infrastructure Cloud (démarche FinOps) et veiller aux performances globales des environnements.

Leadership Technique & Culture DevOps : Porter la culture DevOps/DevSecOps au sein des équipes, évangéliser les bonnes pratiques, rédiger les standards d'architecture et mentorer les ingénieurs juniors/seniors.

3. Compétences Techniques Détaillées (Hard Skills)
A. Containerisation & Écosystème Kubernetes (Expertise Majeure)
Orchestration : Maîtrise approfondie de Kubernetes (architecture des control planes, etcd, kube-proxy, CNI, CSI). Expérience sur les managed clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE) et on-premise (Rancher, OpenShift, k3s).

Networking & Service Mesh : Configuration des CNI (Calico, Cilium, Flannel), gestion des Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) et mise en place de Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) pour la gestion du trafic inter-services.

Stockage & Stateful : Gestion des volumes persistant (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook/Ceph, NFS).

Package Management : Maîtrise de Helm pour le templating et le packaging d'applications.

B. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Providers
Cloud Publics : Maîtrise avancée d'au moins un grand Cloud provider (AWS ou Azure / GCP), ou des environnements OpenStack / VMware pour les contextes on-premise/privés.

IaC & Provisioning : Maîtrise absolue de Terraform / OpenTofu (gestion d'état, modules, remote state) et Ansible pour la configuration.

Immutable Infrastructure : Utilisation d'outils comme Packer pour la génération d'images de VM/conteneurs.

C. CI/CD & Automatisation du Software Delivery
Pipelines CI/CD : Conception de chaînes d'intégration complexes avec GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou Jenkins.

GitOps : Implémentation de paradigmes GitOps avec ArgoCD ou FluxCD pour synchroniser l'état des clusters Kubernetes avec les repositories Git.

D. Observabilité, Monitoring & SRE
Supervision & Métriques : Déploiement et administration de Prometheus, Thanos, Cortex, et design de dashboards sur Grafana.

Centralisation des Logs & Tracing : Maîtrise des stacks d'observabilité (ELK / EFK, Grafana Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

Fiabilité (SRE) : Définition des SLO, SLA et SLI, gestion des alertes et automatisation de la remédiation (incident response).

E. Sécurité (DevSecOps) & Compliance
Software Supply Chain Security : Analyse de vulnérabilités des images (Trivy, Clair), signature d'images (Cosign), SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

title: Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
description:
Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).
• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and their practical implications for data and reporting.
• Strong grasp of data ecosystems, software building skills and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of decisions.
• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

In case you are selected for an interview, you will be asked to present a case study that will be communicated to you in advance.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Operations - (Logistics Service) (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology
- Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets
- You are self-driven and communicative, independent and pragmatic in handling business challenges
- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment
- Excellent hands on knowledge of reporting tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) & strong hands on knowledge in SQL

Nice to have

- Experience using AI tools in everyday work to bring efficiency and automation

- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.

In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.
- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.
- Demonstrated ability to influence executives and align diverse global and regional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong project, change, and vendor-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent global initiatives.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and cross-cultural communication skills; professional fluency in English.
- Fluent in German with a strong knowledge of German laws essential.

What we offer you

- Attractive location: Our location features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team

- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

With our comprehensive 360° offering, we help customers navigate a dynamic technology and competitive landscape, enabling them to build a smarter and more sustainable future. Our 50,000 visionary minds around the world drive innovation through creativity, expertise, and commitment - shaping a more intelligent world for tomorrow.

Client Details

Apply now and help shape the next generation of aircraft interiors and passenger experiences. ✈️

Description

- Lead the integration of passenger seating systems into commercial aircraft platforms, ensuring compatibility with aircraft structures, systems, monuments, and cabin interfaces.
- Define and manage design requirements, validation activities, and verification strategies to achieve compliance with certification and performance requirements.

- Assess technical feasibility, risks, and implementation strategies for both new aircraft production and cabin modification programs.

Profile

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical, Civil, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline
- Strong understanding of aircraft design, integration, and certification principles
- 5+ years of aerospace industry experience in aircraft design, systems integration, cabin interiors, certification, or related engineering disciplines
- Technical Skills: CATIA V5 / V6, ENOVIA, IVT, AutoCAD

Proven experience with aircraft interior design and modification programs, particularly seating and payload installations.

Good knowledge of applicable airworthiness regulations including:

- EASA CS-25
- FAR Part 25

title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

As a global organisation operating across multiple countries, compensation for this role may vary depending on location, local market benchmarks, and experience.
In line with our commitment to pay transparency, a salary range relevant to your location will be shared with you during the early stages of the recruitment process, before any interview is scheduled.

title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.
- Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) and strong working knowledge of German (B1+ minimum).
- Experience in global mobility operations and business travel administration is considered a strong plus.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading

delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

title: Functional Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Functional Analyst (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

The Development & Configuration team is responsible for designing, configuring, and enhancing business applications and systems, ensuring that technology solutions effectively support business objectives and operational efficiency.
We are looking for a Functional Analyst to join our Development & Configuration team in Luxembourg. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear functional requirements and ensuring delivered solutions meet expectations.

Your responsibilities:

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process reviews
• Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications and user stories
• Collaborate closely with development, configuration, and QA teams throughout the project lifecycle
• Perform impact analysis on existing systems and processes for proposed changes
• Support UAT planning and execution, ensuring traceability between requirements and test cases
• Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and IT teams
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes and documentation standards

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field
• 3+ years of experience as a Functional Analyst or Business Analyst, ideally in financial services or post-trade environments
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Experience writing functional specifications and user stories
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); additional Agile certifications or advanced knowledge are considered an asset
• Experience with JIRA and Confluence is an advantage
• Exposure to SQL and data analysis is beneficial
• Knowledge of the fund industry is a plus
• Understanding of regulatory frameworks relevant to Central Securities Depositories (CSDs) or financial market infrastructures is an asset
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; French and/or German are a plus

title: Bauüberwacher für den Erdkabelbau (m/w/d)

INP International Projects ist eine international agierende Ingenieur- und Servicegesellschaft für Prozessleittechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, elektrische Energietechnik, Maschinen- und Schweißtechnik, thermische Verfahrenstechnik sowie Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekte.

Der Erfolg der 2006 gegründeten INP Austria GmbH basiert auf dem Engagement und der überdurchschnittlichen Kompetenz unserer MitarbeiterInnen. title: Electrical Construction Manager
description:
Electrical Construction Manager (Bauleiter Elektrotechnik)

Work tasks: Management of electrical installation teams and allocation of tasks.
Planning of works and monitoring of deadlines and the quality of work performed. Monitoring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, technical requirements and quality standards. Ensuring that works are carried out in accordance with project documentation and technical requirements. Communication and coordination with the client, project management, other contractors and the company's management. Monitoring working hours and completed work volumes. Preparation and management of the required work documentation, reports and protocols. Coordination of the supply of required materials, tools and equipment to construction sites. Timely reporting to the company's management on work progress, deviations from the schedule and any issues arising on construction sites.

We offer: We offer long-term and stable employment in Germany, in the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia (Düsseldorf, Cologne and surrounding areas).
Gross salary of €3,800–€4,500 per month, depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications. The final salary will be agreed individually. Start as soon as possible. The employer provides accommodation in Germany and transportation required for work. The company covers flight tickets to Germany or other agreed travel expenses related to starting work. Official employment with an Estonian company, including the preparation of the necessary documents for working in Germany in accordance with applicable requirements. Work on long-term electrical installation projects. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30–18:00.

Option to work from home: No

secteur manufacturier.

techniques
- Fiabilité avérée, solide éthique de travail et capacité à respecter les protocoles de santé et
de sécurité
- Une expérience préalable dans un environnement de fabrication ou de production est un
atout
Notre environnement de travail

title: Technical Documentation Writer - Defense Technology - Permanent (H/F)
description:
Salary: 65-80k€ (Annuel)

TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION WRITER - DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY (F/M)

Contract type Permanent position (Full-time)

Location Erding / Greater Munich Area, Germany (Hybrid)

Reference 2387

Contact

COMPANY PRESENTATION

Our client is an innovative defense technology company developing next-generation solutions that combine advanced sensors, secure communications, and intelligent data processing. Their systems support military and law enforcement operators by providing reliable situational awareness in demanding operational environments.

KEY POINTS OF THE POSITION

* Own the complete technical documentation landscape across multiple projects
* Work closely with engineering, quality, and production teams
* Play a key role in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment
* Drive documentation quality, consistency, and compliance from development through delivery

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Technical Writer, your responsibilities will include:

* Create and maintain technical datasheets for products, subsystems, and components
* Write user manuals, installation guides, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, structured, version-controlled, and aligned with product evolution
* Gather, review, and organize supplier certificates, test reports, and quality documentation
* Prepare complete documentation packages for customer deliveries, audits, and compliance requirements
* Develop training materials and documentation for internal teams and customers
* Collaborate with engineers to collect, understand, and validate technical information
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they impact projects
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of documentation processes and standards

NECESSARY SKILLS

* Proven experience as a Technical Writer in an industrial or engineering environment
* Strong ability to translate complex technical information into clear and structured documentation
* Experience working with technical specifications, engineering drawings, test reports, and product data
* Familiarity with documentation management, version control, and review processes
* Knowledge of quality standards and regulated environments (ISO 9001 or similar) is highly desirable
* Experience with Jira, Git, or similar documentation/version control tools is a plus
* Background in defense, aerospace, railway, medical devices, electronics, or other critical industries is advantageous
* Flawless German is mandatory
* Professional fluency in English
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
* Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2/Ü2) is required

SALARY

€65,000 - €80,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

----------------------------------------

RHESO.TECH

Specialized recruitment consultancy supporting companies in industry, engineering, advanced technologies, aerospace, defense, and critical systems.

title: Electrical Construction Manager
description:
Electrical Construction Manager (Bauleiter Elektrotechnik)

Work tasks: Management of electrical installation teams and allocation of tasks.
Planning of works and monitoring of deadlines and the quality of work performed. Monitoring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, technical requirements and quality standards. Ensuring that works are carried out in accordance with project documentation and technical requirements. Communication and coordination with the client, project management, other contractors and the company's management. Monitoring working hours and completed work volumes. Preparation and management of the required work documentation, reports and protocols. Coordination of the supply of required materials, tools and equipment to construction sites. Timely reporting to the company's management on work progress, deviations from the schedule and any issues arising on construction sites.

We offer: We offer long-term and stable employment in Germany, in the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia (Düsseldorf, Cologne and surrounding areas).
Gross salary of €3,800–€4,500 per month, depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications. The final salary will be agreed individually. Start as soon as possible. The employer provides accommodation in Germany and transportation required for work. The company covers flight tickets to Germany or other agreed travel expenses related to starting work. Official employment with an Estonian company, including the preparation of the necessary documents for working in Germany in accordance with applicable requirements. Work on long-term electrical installation projects. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30–18:00.

Option to work from home: No

description:

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.

A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.

Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.

Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti auto ad uso promiscuo, PC e telefono aziendale, incentivi legati ai risultati. Prevista formazione iniziale con training 1-2 settimane presso l'HQ in provincia di Treviso. Luogo di lavoro: Emilia-Romagna (ruolo in mobilità: smart working + presidio presso Clienti e cantieri nell'area) - base preferibile Bologna Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: ispettore di pesi e misure/ispettrice di pesi e misure
description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), con un team di consulenti dedicati, si occupa della ricerca e selezione di risorse con esperienza, che hanno voglia di intraprendere nuovi percorsi professionali. I nostri consulenti ti aiuteranno a trovare la migliore opportunità lavorativa, grazie ad un'attenta analisi delle tue competenze e delle tue esperienze. Per solida azienda del settore impianti tecnologici, siamo alla ricerca di un/a FACILITY SPECIALIST Principali responsabilità Il Facility Specialist verrà inserito all'interno di un team e si occuperà delle seguenti attività: Pianificare e supervisionare la manutenzione ordinaria, straordinaria e preventiva degli impianti tecnologici (elettrici, idraulici, condizionamento). Interfacciarsi quotidianamente con i committenti per pianificare gli interventi Supervisionare da remoto le squadre operative on-site, garantendo l'efficienza degli interventi e il rispetto delle tempistiche contrattuali. Redigere report periodici sull'andamento delle attività e interfacciarsi con il committente per aggiornamenti. Gestire eventuali criticità operative e interventi di emergenza, assicurando la continuità del servizio. Si occupa di rifornire le attrezzature per la manutenzione provvedendo all'acquisto dei materiali. Requisiti Esperienza nel ruolo di facility specialist o nel coordinamento di attività legate a manutenzioni in ambito idraulico, edile ed elettrico Diploma o Laurea Conoscenza degli impianti tecnologici Spiccate capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione con clienti, fornitori e team interni. title: paleontologo/paleontologa
description: Our Client is a leading industrial group with a strong manufacturing footprint and established international standards, recognized for operational excellence and a structured, performance-driven culture. To strengthen the Finance function at its manufacturing site in India, we have been retained to search for a: Resident Senior Controller - India The candidate will be responsible for monitoring operational performance of the manufacturing plant in India. The role combines operational analysis and business support, ensuring transparency and alignment with group standards Key responsibilities - Monitor plant performance and key manufacturing KPIs - Analyze production costs, labor efficiency and machine utilization - Manage standard costing, variance analysis and cost allocation - Track bill of materials and manufacturing cost structures - Support operational efficiency and CapEx investment evaluations - Monitor cross-functional KPIs (sales margins, purchasing costs, production volumes, inventory turnover and quality costs) - Coordinate plant budgeting and forecasting processes - Ensure compliance with financial procedures and internal controls - Support audit activities and reporting improvements - Act as financial partner to plant management, providing insights for operational decision-making and facilitating communication with HQ Required profile - 8/10+ years of experience in Controlling, including significant exposure to industrial/manufacturing environments - Strong background in plant controlling within multinational companies - Experience supporting manufacturing operations and working in international environments - Experience with Indian manufacturing operations is highly preferred - Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities - Deep understanding of manufacturing cost structures - Experience working cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement and Sales - ERP experience (SAP preferred) and familiarity with BI tools - Languages: Fluent English - Education: Degree in Business Administration, Finance or Engineering Location India (resident position at the manufacturing plant) Compensation & benefits The company offers an annual gross salary in the range of €70,000 - €100,000, commensurate with experience and role scope, plus company-provided accommodation. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. #LI-BF1 Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: elettricista nel settore dell’illuminazione pubblica

title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich

- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

NEOLAUREATI/E in STATISTICA - ACADEMY JUNIOR DATA SCIENTIST Cerchiamo giovani talenti da formare e inserire come Junior Data Scientist attraverso un percorso di Academy altamente qualificante e totalmente gratuito. Cosa prevede l'Academy: - 4 Settimane di corso virtuale, con data start Lunedì 12 Ottobre 2026; - Lezioni frontali e project work con il supporto di docenti qualificati; - Possibilità di inserimento al termine del percorso tramite contratto a tempo determinato in somministrazione Gi Group; - L'Academy si svolgerà interamente in modalità virtuale; - Corso completamente gratuito per tutti i partecipanti. Che cosa imparerai? Sarai formato/a per ricoprire il ruolo di Junior Data Scientist, sviluppando competenze nell'analisi di grandi volumi di dati e trasformarli in insight utili al business. Lavorerai con Python (anche in ottica OOP) e con strumenti come Pandas e NumPy per preparare, pulire e valorizzare i dataset, fino a realizzare analisi e visualizzazioni efficaci e dashboard. description: Vuoi essere parte del cambiamento digitale e della trasformazione tecnologica? Hai esperienza in ambito ICT e vuoi lavorare su progetti innovativi? Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per conto di CISALFA GROUP, azienda italiana presente in Italia e in Germania con 7 società e le insegne Calafa Sport, INTERSPORT Voswinkel e SportScheck, con più di 240 negozi e 5.500 persone, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di: CYBER SECURITY ENGINEER La risorsa opererà in stretta collaborazione con il Cyber Security Architect, il SOC e i team IT, contribuendo all'implementazione, alla gestione operativa e al continuo miglioramento delle soluzioni di sicurezza aziendali. Il ruolo ha una forte componente tecnico-operativa e prevede la responsabilità diretta sull'esecuzione dei controlli di sicurezza, sul monitoraggio degli eventi e sul supporto alle attività di incident management, in ambienti sia on-premise sia cloud. Cosa farai: - Implementare, configurare e gestire operativamente soluzioni di sicurezza enterprise (EDR/XDR, SIEM, firewall, IDS/IPS, IAM) - Monitorare gli eventi di sicurezza e analizzare i log per individuare anomalie e potenziali minacce - Supportare le attività di incident response, investigazione tecnica e contenimento degli incidenti - Gestire endpoint, server e infrastrutture dal punto di vista della sicurezza - Collaborare con il SOC e con fornitori esterni per l'analisi e la risoluzione degli alert - Supportare le attività di vulnerability assessment e la remediation delle vulnerabilità - Contribuire all'implementazione delle misure di sicurezza definite dall'architettura (security by design) - Fornire supporto operativo su temi di backup, disaster recovery e continuità operativa Competenze tecniche richieste: - Esperienza pratica con soluzioni EDR/XDR, SIEM e sistemi di logging centralizzato - Conoscenza dei principali meccanismi di sicurezza di rete (firewall, VPN, IDS/IPS) - Capacità di analisi di log ed eventi di sicurezza - Conoscenza dello stack TCP/IP e dei principali protocolli di rete - Comprensione dei principi di crittografia, gestione dei certificati e protocolli sicuri (TLS, SSH) - Esperienza o familiarità con soluzioni di Identity & Access Management - Familiarità con ambienti cloud Orario di lavoro: 8 ore al giorno, dal lunedì al venerdì con flessibilità in entrata dalle 8:30 alle 10:00 e pausa pranzo obbligatoria di 1 ora( tra 12:30 e 15:00). description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2
