title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

General information:

• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research scientist
• Job Reference: UOL08342

Gender equality:

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Head of Property Management (h/f)
description:
Head of Property Management F/H

Reference: LU878379

Luxembourg
Permanent
Property and Real Estate

Notre client est un acteur reconnu du secteur immobilier au Luxembourg. Dans le cadre de sa croissance, nous recherchons pour son compte un(e) Head of Property Management afin de piloter la stratégie et le développement de son département Property Management.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous définissez et pilotez la stratégie du département Property Management. Vous êtes garant(e) de la performance globale de l'activité, de la qualité des services délivrés aux clients, de la rentabilité du département et du développement du portefeuille sous gestion.
Véritable manager, vous encadrez et fédérez les équipes en charge des volets administratifs, comptables, techniques et opérationnels, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fluidité des actions menées au service des clients et des immeubles gérés.

Ce poste combine un fort volet management d'équipes, un rôle actif dans le développement commercial et la croissance du portefeuille immobilier, ainsi qu'une dimension stratégique auprès de la Direction.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie, les objectifs et les priorités du département Property Management.
• Piloter la performance opérationnelle et financière de l'activité au moyen d'indicateurs de suivi pertinents.
• Manager, accompagner et fédérer les équipes afin de garantir un haut niveau d'expertise, d'engagement et de qualité de service.
• Superviser l'ensemble du portefeuille immobilier sous gestion et assurer le respect des mandats, engagements contractuels et standards de qualité.
• Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les propriétaires, investisseurs et principaux clients.
• Superviser les dossiers complexes, sensibles ou présentant des enjeux financiers, juridiques, techniques ou réputationnels.
• Contribuer activement au développement commercial, au property development, aux appels d'offres et à l'intégration de nouveaux mandats afin d'accroître le portefeuille sous gestion.
• Garantir la rentabilité du département, le suivi budgétaire et la maîtrise des risques.
• Veiller à l'amélioration continue des processus, à l'harmonisation des pratiques et au respect des procédures internes.
• Piloter les projets de transformation digitale et favoriser l'adoption des nouveaux outils par les équipes.
• Intégrer les enjeux ESG, réglementaires et de conformité dans les pratiques de gestion.
• Assurer une communication régulière avec la Direction et favoriser les synergies avec les autres départements.

Votre profil

• Formation supérieure en immobilier, gestion, finance, droit, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée dans le secteur immobilier et dans une fonction de management en Property Management, Property Development ou dans une activité comparable.
• Une connaissance du marché luxembourgeois est apprécié.
• Véritable expertise en management d'équipes, avec une expérience solide dans l'encadrement de collaborateurs, la gestion de clients institutionnels et de portefeuilles immobiliers complexes.
• Track record démontré en développement commercial.
• Leadership affirmé, forte orientation client et capacité à fédérer.
• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, d'analyse, de négociation et de communication.
• Esprit entrepreneurial, rigueur, sens des responsabilités et goût pour l'amélioration continue.
• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais ; la connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

description:

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg
We are seeking a Staff Services Supervisor (m/f/d) to join our Facilities team.
As a Workplace Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating the team, overseeing daily operations and ensuring a consistently high level of employee and internal client satisfaction.

You will be responsible for:

•    Coordinating daily Staff Services operations and ensuring high-quality service delivery.
•    Planning and organizing work, including timelines, resource allocation and prioritization.
•    Managing and monitoring multiple activities and projects simultaneously, ensuring effective follow-up.
•    Supervising, coaching and supporting a team of junior staff members.
•    Organizing schedules, prioritizing workloads, delegating effectively and managing team capacity.
•    Acting as a primary point of contact for external service providers, overseeing contracts and managing attendance schedules.
•    Monitoring employee and internal client satisfaction, collecting feedback and coordinating appropriate actions.
•    Developing and contributing to high-quality internal concierge services and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
•    Strengthening the visibility of the team and developing effective relationships with other internal teams.
•    Ensuring service delivery, processes and deadlines are met in line with internal standards, service commitments and employee expectations.
What you will be working on

You will lead and support the continuous development of Staff Services, including:

•    Supervising daily operational activities and ensuring consistent service quality.
•    Leading, training and mentoring team members to deliver exceptional, hotel-grade service standards.
•    Managing team schedules, workloads and priorities to ensure efficient resource allocation.
•    Monitoring activities and preparing regular performance reports and KPIs.
•    Identifying operational gaps, analyzing root causes and proposing sustainable solutions.
•    Leading operational projects from needs identification and business case development through to provider engagement, process design, testing, deployment and change communication.
•    Identifying opportunities for process improvements, efficiency gains and operational innovation.
•    Developing and expanding concierge service offerings and identifying new value-adding services and partnerships.
•    Supporting the development of team members through regular feedback, coaching and individual development plans.
•    Fostering a motivating work environment that encourages initiative, continuous improvement and the sharing of best practices.

What we look for

•    A graduate-level qualification.
•    At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar position.
•    Proven experience in supervising a team and managing administrative activities.
•    Strong project and team management skills, including performance management and decision-making.
•    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
•    Excellent organizational, prioritization and time management skills.
•    A pragmatic and solution-oriented approach, with strong problem-solving capabilities.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
•    Strong client and employee orientation, with a focus on service quality and satisfaction.
•    Experience in team leadership and people management, with the ability to coach, motivate and develop staff.
•    Experience in concierge, hospitality or a similar service-oriented environment, demonstrating strong operational knowledge and practical problem-solving under pressure.
•    Ability to analyze operational performance, identify gaps and propose appropriate improvements.
•    Strong administrative capabilities and technical knowledge.
•    Flexibility, adaptability and collaboration.
•    Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Marketing & Communication Manager | SEB, Luxembourg

SEB is a leading international financial services group with a strong and well-established client base among both corporate and financial institutions. We consistently earn recognition for our expertise and customer centric approach, achievements made possible by truly listening to our clients, committing to quality and trust, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset throughout the organization.  

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. As part of the new strategy for PWM&FO we aim to become the leading wealth accumulator in our core markets and that requires a state-of-the-art core banking offering and financial infrastructure. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions.

SEB in Luxembourg has supported our home market clients with their international needs since 1973. Today the Branch has approximately 170 employees of over 25 different nationalities.

About the role

You will be part of a team, executing on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda. We foster an inclusive leadership culture built on empowerment and involvement to creating an environment where innovation can thrive.  
As the Marketing & Communication Manager for SEB AB Luxembourg Branch, your responsibilities stretch across borders, including PWM&FO in Luxembourg, Singapore, Norway, Finland and the United Kingdom, as well as our support offices in Nice and Switzerland. You will act as a strategic partner to the business, supporting growth and development by aligning marketing and communication activities with business objectives.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Overall responsibility for the coordination and implementation of the SEB Group Marketing and Communications approach in relation to corporate branding, visual and written identity. Daily tasks include maintenance and development of templates, internal awareness-raising and education activities, and providing advice on sponsoring and other branding matters.
• Maintaining close collaboration with the SEB Group Marketing and Communications department, other relevant stakeholders across the business division, and external parties.
• Responsible for production, distribution and record-keeping of marketing materials, including product sheets, sales material, newsletters, brochures, advertisements and event invitations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with cross-border policies and standards.  
• Support the planning and coordination of events in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, including the creation and distribution of invitations and follow-up activities.
• Responsible for external and internal communications, including production, distribution and record-keeping of client letters, newsletters, reports, statements, social media content and press materials. Support the bank`s employer branding, employee engagement and networking activities.
• Own & manage the banks of web and digital channels, including  creation, publication, and maintenance of content in internal and external platforms.
• Support the development of marketing and communication initiatives that strengthen the SEB brand and support business priorities.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

We believe you will bring a combination of marketing and communication expertise, strong project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, taking ownership of your responsibilities while maintaining a structured approach to delivering high-quality results.
You demonstrate integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information, communicate effectively with wide range of stakeholders and can combine practical problem-solving skills with analytical thinking.

In addition, you have:

• At least 3 years of working experience, with proven track record of working with Marketing and / or Communication.
• A bachelor's or master's degree within Marketing or another relevant field
• Experience planning and coordinating marketing and communication initiative across multiple channels
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite tools such as InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, combined with strong Microsoft Office skills
• Fluency in written and spoken English and Swedish, or other Scandinavian languages
• Knowledge of any of the three official languages in Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish) is considered a strong advantage in dealing with local stakeholders, press and other external stakeholders.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• Innovative company at the forefront of technology international opportunities and working environment
• Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits 
• A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
• Possibility to work from home part of the working time
• A diverse, inclusive and equal environment with focus on health & wellbeing

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  
Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts:
https://sebgroup.com/career & https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

About the LCSB
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. We excel because we are truly interdisciplinary, and together we contribute to science and society.

Your role
We seek a highly motivated software developer to join a FNR JUMP-funded project translating a validated suite of bioinformatics software tools into CausalOmics, an integrated software platform for causal analysis of omics data. The platform identifies root causal genes and candidate drug targets from multi-omics datasets.
The candidate will contribute to the further development of the unified, point-and-click user interface, implement interactive visualization frameworks for complex biological networks, and develop the core platform architecture that connects the analysis modules, spanning preprocessing, network and pathway analysis, causal reasoning, drug target assessment, and machine learning, through robust APIs.
Further responsibilities include setting up the cloud deployment infrastructure (SaaS architecture, REST API) and ensuring the platform is scalable, reproducible, and accessible to users without coding or bioinformatics expertise. The role is closely linked to the CausalOmics go-to-market project, and the candidate will work directly with the project's principal investigator and its interdisciplinary bioinformatics and business development team.
This position is offered with the explicit intent that the successful candidate may take on the role of Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Lead Developer of the planned CausalOmics spin-off company after incorporation.

Your profile
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field: MSc or equivalent; PhD an advantage
• Proven experience in full-stack web development, including front-end frameworks and back-end/API design
• Experience with interactive data visualization and building user-friendly, no-code interfaces for complex analytical workflows
• Familiarity with cloud deployment (SaaS architectures, REST APIs, CI/CD) is highly advantageous
• An interest in, or prior exposure to, bioinformatics or biomedical data is a plus but not required
• Strong software architecture and code quality skills, including experience with scalable, modular system design
• Cross-disciplinary aptitude, strong organizational and interpersonal skills, and interest in a translational, commercially oriented research environment
• Excellent command in English

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

description:
Job Description

Senior Corporate Governance Officer

Location: Luxembourg

1. Overview

1.1 ONE corporate (“ONE”) is a dynamic and young business focused on delivering quality, value-add, next-gen company secretarial and corporate governance support to a wide variety of clients. We are looking for a governance specialist to manage a portfolio of clients and lead a team responsible for delivering ONE's core services. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced, passionate and career driven governance specialist to work in a flexible and energetic culture focused on delivering premium company secretarial support services.

2. Your Role

2.1 Title: Senior Corporate Governance Officer
2.2 Reports To: Manager, Corporate Governance
2.3 Function: The Senior Corporate Governance Officer supports the Manager, Corporate Governance in the delivery of Company Secretarial and Domiciliation Support Services to clients of ONE.
2.4 Location: Luxembourg

3. Your Attitude and Skills

3.1 You are passionate about your field, understand the importance of corporate governance and are excited about delivering a great product. Entrepreneurial in mind-set, you take ownership, strive to grow relationships, develop the people around you and seek out new opportunities for growth & improvement. You take pride in your work and you view the successes of your colleagues and of ONE as your own.
3.2 You are keen to work in a dynamic, flexible culture that is focused on the job, not the hours; providing you a high degree of autonomy and flexibility as to where and when you work.
3.3 You enjoy a challenge, don't shy away from taking on responsibilities outside of your core role and are at ease talking with, supporting and challenging senior management / board members.
3.4 You hold a Bachelor's degree (or higher/equivalent), have experience relevant to this role (minimum 3 years) and in supporting a variety of alternative and/or UCITS fund structures and like to keep up-to-date with the latest trends in governance practice. You either hold a related Company Secretarial / Corporate Governance qualification or would be keen to study one with our financial support. You have a great command of English and knowledge of other languages would be a plus.

4. What we offer

4.1 A chance to be a driving force behind a growing success story at a young and exciting firm with a culture focused on the successes of its staff and clients. An environment with driven people, who have an entrepreneurial mindset, to help support your development ambitions.

5. Your Responsibilities and Duties

5.1 Leadership Responsibilities:
5.1.1 Support the mentoring of junior members of the team of corporate secretaries and dedicated minute takers to deliver top-tier, responsive and quality focused company secretarial services commensurate with ONE's corporate culture and product offering.
5.1.2 Assist the Manager, Corporate Governance, to manage a portfolio of boards and clients as the lead relationship manager, responsible for overseeing the delivery of services.
5.1.3 Assist with tracking events for invoicing purposes and assist with the invoicing process through to collection of fees.
5.1.4 Assist with the client on-boarding and review process.
5.2 Operational Responsibilities:
5.2.1 Support and deliver Company Secretarial and Registered Office / Domiciliation Support Services in a team environment on a timely basis consistent with client commitments/SLAs.
5.3 Core responsibilities include:

• Acting as a key point of contact with clients, boards, administrators, regulators, counsel and other third parties.
• Support clients and boards with best corporate governance practice.
• Organise and attend Board, Shareholder and Committee meetings for a varied portfolio of clients.
• Take and/or review meeting minutes and resolutions.
• Facilitate and project manage transactions.
• Travel to board meetings (within Luxembourg).
• Support company incorporations.
• Prepare and submit filings with the regulator and Luxembourg Business Registers.
• Maintain corporate records and statutory registers.
• Presenting a professional image in line with our company culture: enthusiastic, upbeat and engaging.

title: Head of Channel Partnerships (m/f)
description:
Head of Channel Partnerships

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit an experienced Head of Channel Partnerships to join our global team.

Position Overview:  

Reporting to the Managing Director – Global Growth, the Head of Channel Partnerships will lead Sonata One's global channel partnership strategy function, driving commercial growth through the development of strategic relationships across the private markets ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity to join Sonata One at a pivotal stage in our growth journey as we invest significantly in building a world-class commercial organisation. You will play a key role in shaping our partnerships strategy, and helping expand Sonata One's presence across the global private markets industry.
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing and managing strategic partnerships that generate new commercial opportunities, strengthen long-term client relationships and expand Sonata One's market presence. Working closely with the New Business team, Marketing, Product, Technology and Operations, you will help deliver Sonata One's ambitious commercial growth strategy while ensuring our partner ecosystem continues to create value for clients around the world.

Responsibilities:  

Revenue Generation

• Develop and execute the global channel partnership strategy to support Sonata One's commercial growth objectives.  
• Identify opportunities to generate new revenue through strategic partnerships, cross-selling and partner-led opportunities.  
• Work closely with the New Business team to maximise commercial opportunities generated through partner relationships.  
• Support joint go-to-market initiatives and marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness and generate qualified opportunities.  

Strategic Partnership Development

• Identify, evaluate and establish new strategic partnerships across the private markets ecosystem.  
• Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned to Sonata One's commercial objectives.  
• Expand Sonata One's partner network across key global markets.  
• Assess prospective partners based on market reach, client base, strategic fit and long-term commercial value.  

Relationship Management

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organisations.  
• Act as the primary executive contact for strategic partners.  
• Develop engagement plans that maximise partner success and long-term collaboration.  
• Proactively resolve issues and identify opportunities to strengthen relationships.  

Performance & Growth

• Establish KPIs to measure partnership success.  
• Monitor pipeline performance, commercial outcomes and partner engagement.  
• Use market insights and performance data to continuously improve partnership strategies.  
• Deliver accurate commercial forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.  

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing to improve awareness, engagement and partner enablement.  
• Work closely with Product and Technology teams to ensure partner feedback informs future product development.  
• Collaborate with Legal to support commercial agreements and partnership governance where required.  
 

Compensation:
• Industry leading base salary - EUR 130,000 - 200,000 depending on experience.

Qualifications:  
 
• Proven experience in a senior partnerships, business development or commercial leadership role.  
• Demonstrable success developing strategic partnerships within fintech, financial services, fund services or private markets.  
• Strong understanding of the private markets ecosystem, including fund managers, institutional investors and service providers.  
• Existing network across the private markets industry would be highly advantageous.  
• Experience leading and developing high-performing commercial or relationship management teams.  
• Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.  
• Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute partnership strategies.  
• Analytical mindset with experience using commercial data to drive decision making.  
• Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.  
• Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce would be advantageous.  
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.  

Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Everyone has an important role to fulfil, and your contribution will be an integral part of our success story.   
  
Benefits:   

• Life Insurance – Peace of mind for you and your loved ones 
• Income Protection – Financial support when you need it most 
• Hybrid Working – Supporting work/Life Balance 
• Annual Leave – With extra days that grow the longer you're with us 
• Pension Scheme – Employee matched helping you plan confidently for the future 
• Employee Assistance Program – Confidential, 24/7 support for life's ups and downs 
• Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave – Because family matters 
• Career Training & Development – Ongoing learning opportunities to help you grow 
• Paid Volunteering Day – Take time to give back to causes you care about 
• Cycle to work Scheme – Employees can benefit from significant tax savings on bicycles and cycling equipment
• Work From Anywhere – Choose your backdrop

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. Its general objective is to enable Luxembourg to establish and deploy services for its HDAB, at minimum:
• processing and management of data access applications,
• supporting secure processing of health data by data users,
• making sure that they are well integrated in the EHDS,
• establishing and aligning with EU standards,
• and providing cross-border connections for large-scale deployment of HealthData@EU based on the work conducted by the joint action TEHDaS.

You will work closely with the technology team to deliver high-quality services to the HDAB's end users, including data applicants and data users seeking access to health data for secondary use. • Evaluate and deploy new technologies and tools to keep the infrastructure relevant.
• Assist to manage the Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions in place.
• Deploy, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, and networking using different configuration management tools.

As a Data Governance Officer, you will support the operational implementation of the Bank's Data Strategy and BCBS 239 programme. • Embed Data Governance requirements in data and IT projects throughout the data lifecycle.
• Contribute to the improvement and automation of operational Data Governance processes and controls.
• Maintain evidence supporting BCBS 239, internal control, audit and regulatory requirements.
• Use Microsoft 365, Power BI, Copilot and relevant AI-enabled automation capabilities to improve efficiency and ways of working.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• One to three years of professional experience working with data, preferably in banking or financial services.

• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

• Understanding of Business Glossary, metadata management, data ownership and data lineage concepts.
• Practical experience with Power BI, including data analysis and the creation or maintenance of dashboards.
• Strong command of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and relevant AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.
• Knowledge of BCBS 239 or banking regulatory data requirements is an advantage.
• Highly self-driven, proactive and able to take ownership of assigned activities with limited supervision.
• Hands-on and comfortable working directly with data, tools and governance artefacts.
• Analytical, structured and attentive to detail.
• Strong team player who collaborates effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Able to challenge inconsistencies constructively, follow up with stakeholders and drive activities to completion.
• Curious about data, technology and AI, with a continuous improvement and automation mindset.

Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

• Support the deployment and continuous enhancement of the Company's outsourcing governance framework.
• Ensure outsourced activities remain aligned with applicable regulations, internal standards and governance requirements.
• Oversee the maintenance and accuracy of the outsourcing inventory.
• Manage and maintain outsourcing-related records, contractual agreements and service documentation.
• Liaise with key internal and external stakeholders involved in outsourcing activities.

2. Risk Assessment & Supplier Due Diligence

• Facilitate initial and ongoing risk evaluations of outsourced functions and services.
• Conduct or coordinate due diligence reviews on external providers and intra-group entities.
• Ensure outsourcing-related risks are appropriately identified, evaluated and documented within the Company's risk management framework.

3. ICT Vendor Oversight

• Oversee ICT outsourcing arrangements, including services delivered by the Group Head Office.
• Monitor service quality through the review of performance reports, KPIs and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Verify that service providers comply with contractual obligations and operational expectations.
• Collaborate with Group IT teams to address performance, service delivery and operational matters.

4. Service Monitoring & Management Reporting

• Gather and assess operational and performance data from outsourced service providers and intra-group entities.
• Track adherence to agreed service levels and performance metrics.
• Produce regular management reports on outsourcing activities and provider performance.
• Escalate significant incidents, service disruptions or SLA breaches to the designated outsourcing manager.

5. Incident Management & Remediation

• Identify and monitor issues affecting outsourced services.
• Coordinate corrective actions with service providers and relevant stakeholders.
• Maintain accurate records of incidents, remediation plans and follow-up activities.

6. IT Support & Local Coordination

• Good knowledge of CSSF circular 22/806 and security frameworks (ISO 27001 or similar) and leading practices.

title: Senior Business Developer, Asset Servicing, PWM&FO International, SEB Luxembourg (m/f)
employer: SKANDINAVISKA ENSKILDA BANKEN AB Luxembourg Branch S.A.E.
description:
The Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) division unites the three business areas - Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO), Asset Management, and Life, and together with the newly established product area Investments & Trading Solutions, the WAM division has a clear purpose to significantly strengthen the offering and grow within the wealth and asset management segments.

PWM&FO offers comprehensive banking services, access to capital markets, financing solutions and individually tailored advisory services. The advisory services are based on SEB's vast range of financing and investment products. PWM&FO has a local presence in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, UK, and representative offices in Nice and Zurich.

SEB in Luxembourg serves as the hub for PWM&FO to Nordic nationals living abroad. We are around 150 employees with more than 20 different nationalities.

About the team

The Asset Servicing team supports clients of PWM&FO International by providing active client service and a solid financial infrastructure for banking products and services, such as cash management, custody, accounting, portfolio solutions and investment structures.
The team was established to manage and develop Asset Servicing solutions to professional clients of PWMFO International. The team manage the relationships with both internal stakeholders and selected external partners that are part of the value proposition that we offer to our clients. Through our broader team of Asset Servicing professionals, we secure a robust service delivery and continuous product development, providing clients of PWM&FO International with access to a comprehensive Asset Servicing offering.  

About the role

In this role as an experienced Business Developer, you will be driving our commercial agenda securing delivery of Asset Servicing solutions fitting to the needs of existing and new clients.  Working closely with our Product Managers and the Coverage teams across SEB Group, you will execute on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda.

Your responsibilities include the following but are not limited to:

• Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities in line with growth strategy
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, and key stakeholders
• Analyse market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to inform opportunity development
• Develop value propositions, business cases and proposals
• Support negotiation and contracting activities to secure profitable outcomes
• Manage and maintain a qualified pipeline, including forecasting and reporting
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery feasibility and commercial alignment

What we are looking for

• At least 10 years of working experience, ideally within the International Asset Servicing Industry
• Preferably a bachelor's or master's degree in economics or a related field
• Proven commercial track record
• Structured and solution oriented-oriented approach to work
• High degree of personal integrity and ability to handle confidentiality in a professional way
• Strong networking and relationship building skills
• Good communication and interpersonal skills with a genuine interest in banking and finance
• Fluency in English and a Nordic language. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• International opportunities and empowering working environment
• Long-term stability 
• Extensive training and learning opportunities
• A diverse and inclusive workplace culture that values collaboration and individuality 

Ready to join?

title: Chef / Cheffe d'unité Service Management (m/f)
employer: CFL - Société Nationale Des Chemins De Fer Luxembourgeois S.C.L.
description:
Description de tâches:
Nous sommes aujourd'hui l'un des plus grands employeurs du Grand-Duché et comptons parmi les recruteurs les plus actifs. Attentifs aux besoins de notre Groupe, comme de ceux de nos employés et employées, nous recrutons, intégrons et accompagnons chaque année plusieurs dizaines de nouveaux collaborateurs et collaboratrices de tous horizons, de tous profils. L'expansion de nos activités nous pousse à la recherche incessante de nouveaux talents qui, tous ensemble, nourrissent la diversité de notre grande famille CFL.

Notre Service Informatique se propose d'engager, pour une entrée immédiate, un ou une

CHEF / CHEFFE D'UNITÉ SERVICE MANAGEMENT

Ce poste est à pourvoir à temps plein, bénéficie du flexitime et est éligible au télétravail.

L'embauche est définitive à la suite d'une période de stage rémunérée de 2 ans, comprenant des formations et des évaluations.

Votre mission :

En tant que Chef ou Cheffe d'unité Service Management, vous pilotez l'organisation qui garantit la maîtrise de bout en bout des services IT, de leur prise en charge jusqu'à leur amélioration continue. Vous êtes responsable du cadre ITSM, des processus de Service Management, du support de niveau 1 et 2, ainsi que de la mesure de la qualité de service, en alignement avec les objectifs de la division COO.

Vous veillez à ce que chaque demande, incident ou dysfonctionnement dispose d'un responsable clairement identifié, soit traité selon sa priorité et fasse l'objet d'une communication transparente. Vous mobilisez les unités expertes lorsque nécessaire, tout en maintenant une responsabilité de bout en bout vis-à-vis des utilisateurs et des métiers.

Dans ce cadre, il vous incombera notamment de :



Piloter l'unité et sa transformation

* Vous encadrez les collaborateurs /collaboratrices internes et les prestataires externes, organisez les activités et arbitrez les priorités et les ressources
* Vous définissez la feuille de route de l'unité et accompagnez l'évolution des pratiques, des compétences et de la culture de service
* Vous développez une collaboration structurée entre le support, les unités techniques, les équipes applicatives et les métiers

Garantir la gouvernance du Service Management

* Vous assurez la cohérence et l'amélioration des processus Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge et Event Management
* Vous confiez leur pilotage opérationnel aux responsables désignés, fixez leurs objectifs et en contrôlez l'efficacité
* Vous clarifiez les rôles et responsabilités afin d'anticiper les besoins et d'optimiser la qualité de service

Piloter la qualité et la performance des services

* Vous définissez les engagements de service avec les métiers et les fournisseurs, notamment les SLA et OLA
* Vous garantissez la qualité des données ITSM, des indicateurs et des tableaux de bord nécessaires au pilotage
* Vous organisez les revues de performance et transformez les constats en plans d'amélioration mesurables

Améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et l'efficacité du support

* Vous développez une prise en charge proactive, transparente et orientée utilisateur
* Vous réduisez les incidents récurrents en renforçant le Problem Management, la gestion des connaissances et l'analyse des causes racines
* Vous développez le shift-left, le self-service et l'automatisation lorsque ces leviers améliorent concrètement la qualité et l'efficacité du service

Gérer les escalades, les crises et la continuité de service

* Vous assurez le rôle de point d'escalade pour les situations dépassant les mécanismes opérationnels standards
* Vous coordonnez la réponse aux incidents majeurs et aux crises avec les unités techniques, les métiers et les autres parties prenantes
* Vous pilotez les processus de continuité et de reprise des services, et veiller à leur mise à l'épreuve régulière avec les responsables techniques

Garantir la conformité et l'amélioration continue

* Vous veillez à la conformité, à l'auditabilité et à la discipline opérationnelle des activités de l'unité
* Vous intégrez les exigences de sécurité et de résilience, notamment celles liées à NIS2, en collaboration avec les équipes spécialisées
* Vous faites évoluer en permanence l'organisation, les processus et les outils sur la base des résultats mesurés et des retours des utilisateurs



Votre profil :

* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de Master en gestion de projets, informatique, gestion des systèmes d'information ou dans un domaine équivalent
* Vous justifiez d'une expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 ans dans une fonction similaire
* Vous disposez de solides connaissances en Service Management, ITSM, Service Level Management, Service Delivery Management et gouvernance des services IT
* Vous êtes capable de piloter des activités de conformité, d'audit, de continuité d'activité et de reprise d'activité
* Vous avez de bonnes connaissances des exigences liées à la sécurité du système d'information, notamment en lien avec NIS2, et travaillez efficacement avec les équipes spécialisées telles que le CISO
* Vous êtes à l'aise dans la création de modèles de systèmes, de diagrammes et d'une documentation complète
* Vous possédez des compétences en gestion de projets, planification, coordination, gestion des risques et suivi budgétaire
* Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des publics techniques et non techniques
* Vous êtes capable de recueillir les besoins, d'analyser les demandes des clients et utilisateurs et de transmettre des informations de manière claire et structurée
* Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, d'esprit d'équipe, de résistance au stress et d'une bonne capacité d'écoute
* Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et sécurité, tout en démontrant de bonnes capacités d'organisation, de planification, de supervision et de délégation
* Vous faites preuve de leadership et êtes capable de fédérer, responsabiliser et accompagner les équipes dans un environnement IT exigeant et en constante évolution
* Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. La maîtrise de l'allemand et du luxembourgeois constitue un atout
* Vous avez la nationalité d'un pays membre de l'Union européenne.

À la recherche d'un nouveau défi professionnel ?

Vous pouvez déposer votre candidature via ce site pour le 15/10/2026 au plus tard.

Votre recruteuse, Caroline HORNBECK reste à votre entière disposition par e-mail pour tout renseignement complémentaire :





Vos obligations administratives :

* Une preuve de l'intégralité de vos activités professionnelles passées (certificat de travail, certificat d'affiliation, relevé de carrière, etc.) devra être fournie au cours du processus de recrutement. Ces documents devront être fournis sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.
* Un extrait de votre casier judiciaire luxembourgeois (bulletin numéro 3 et éventuellement numéro 4), - ainsi que de votre pays de résidence si vous ne résidez pas au Luxembourg - datant de moins de 3 mois sera également à fournir sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.

Envie de découvrir les CFL de l'intérieur ?

Découvrez notre blog dédié à nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, à leurs métiers et leurs passions : www.WEARECFL.lu

Le Groupe CFL, employeur de l'égalité des chances

Au sein du Groupe CFL, nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. Nous œuvrons pour un environnement de travail respectueux et adapté, où la diversité prend racine et où l'inclusion est la norme, car nous savons que le sentiment d'unité permet à chacun et chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel.

description:
Nous sommes une association luxembourgeoise forte de ses 38 ans d'engagement dans le secteur social luxembourgeois. title: Assessment & Examinations Coordinator part-time (m/f)
description:
Are you someone who brings clarity, accuracy and calm to complex processes? Do you enjoy coordinating many moving parts while keeping people informed, supported and confident?
The International School of Luxembourg (“ISL”) is looking for an Assessment & Examinations Coordinator to support well-organised, inclusive and student-centred examination experiences across Grades 9–12. Working closely with the Assistant Principal for High School Academic Pathways / DP Coordinator, the Upper School Student Records and Schedule Specialist, and Faculty members, you will coordinate examination and assessment processes, including those of the IB Diploma Programme (“DP”).
This role combines careful organisation with a strong human focus. You will help students and families navigate examination processes, support individual access needs and ensure that important assessment milestones are managed with care, accuracy and integrity.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.
What will you do?
You will use your skills to:
● Plan and coordinate IB DP, mock and internal examinations, including schedules, venues, materials and invigilation;
● Communicate examination requirements, schedules and procedures clearly to students, families, colleagues and invigilators;
● Collaborate with Learner Support and IT colleagues to implement approved inclusive access arrangements;
● Recruit, prepare and coordinate external examination invigilators;
● Maintain confidentiality, examination security and accurate records within IB and school systems;
● Respond calmly and practically to changing circumstances during examination periods;
● Coordinate CAT4 testing across the Upper School; and
● Work collaboratively across Academic Pathways, Data Management, Learner Support, IT and teaching teams.
You will work an average of 16 hours per week in a two-week reference period, and these hours must be worked between 07:00-17:00h during the work week. Your actual schedule can be finalised through discussion with the Assistant Principal for High School Academic Pathways / DP Coordinator based on your personal situation and school needs.
The workload follows the examination cycle, with busier periods around registration, mock examinations, the May IB examination session and the release of results. Flexibility is therefore important, and some additional hours, early mornings, evenings or occasional public-holiday work may be required during peak periods.
What skills will you bring?
Essential:
We are interested in what you can do and how you work, rather than one career path.
● Organisation and prioritisation – coordinating complex processes, managing competing deadlines and following through reliably;
● Accuracy and attention to detail – handling data, documentation and processes carefully and consistently;
● Communication and relationship-building – communicating clearly and respectfully with young people and adults from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds;
● Collaboration and ownership – working effectively across teams while taking responsibility for your own work;
● Problem-solving and composure – thinking clearly, adapting and finding practical solutions under pressure;
● Integrity and discretion – handling confidential information and examination materials responsibly;
● Inclusive practice – working with colleagues to ensure students can access assessment equitably;
● Digital confidence – using and learning digital systems, including Excel, Word, Outlook and databases;
● Full professional fluency in English; and
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.
Valued Experience:
Your transferable skills may have been developed in education or in another complex, deadline-driven environment.
● Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:
● Coordinating administrative processes, assessments, examinations or events;
● Working in a school, university or similarly regulated environment;
● Supporting students, young people or families;
● Working with confidential data, databases or student information systems;
● Working within an international or multicultural environment;
● The IB Diploma Programme, external examinations or standardised testing such as CAT4.
● Working knowledge of French or German, and Luxembourgish, would be an advantage.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management (m/f)
description:
Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10552964 | Amazon Europe Core SARL - LUX

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are on the cutting edge in automated large-scale business, inventory and supply chain planning and optimization systems. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.

The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Responsibilities may include:

- Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
- Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
- Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
- Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
- Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
- Developing dashboards and insight products
- Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
