Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

 

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

title: Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

A temporary position as Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules is available within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) network HubMOL. The position is for a period of two years and three months. It will be affiliated with the Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Group at The Department of Arctic and Marine Biology at UiT. The candidate will be enrolled in the Ph.D. program at the faculty. The research project will be on mathematical modelling approaches targeting mitochondrial metabolism of hub molecules with focus on metabolic flux analysis.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. 


The position's field of Research

The main task of the project will be the reconstruction of models of mitochondrial biochemistry with strong focus on transport and dynamics of hub molecules and related post translational modifications and the development of new approaches for metabolic flux analyses to unravel the impact of changes in hub molecules on protein modification dynamics. 


Qualifications

Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) education program enrollment requirements:

  • The candidate must not have completed a PhD. 
  • The candidate must not have lived, studied or worked for more than12 months in Norway within the last 36 months. 
  • The candidate should describe his/her motivation to join the project and how his/her prior experience will help to develop the project.
  • The position requires to spend several month in other research institutions within the network. 

Required qualifications: 

  • Successfully completed a master in biochemistry, biophysics, or mathematical biology or similar qualification.
  • Strong background in mathematics as well as programming experience in Python.
  • Good understanding of biochemistry.
  • Documented good written and oral  proficiency in English language.
  • We are looking for a colleague with excellent cooperation skills, and a positive attitude towards collaborative research, education and outreach. The successful candidate must have ambitions for a Ph.D. and be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

Additional desirable qualifications, knowledge and experience: 

  • experience in the use of advanced AI models
  • working experience in mathematical modelling of biological pathways beyond the master, especially metabolic flux analysis - 
  • experience in the interpretation of metabolomics mass spectrometry data

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Application

The applicants may be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants'
qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position. The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter including a description of interests, motivation and reasons for applying for the position.
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work. 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all relevant degrees, in original language and translated). 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable.
  • Two references with contact details. 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important.
  • Documentation of English proficiency. Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 
    • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
    • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
    • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
    • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
    • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 
    • Or, by using alternatives listed here.

All of the documentation in the application has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no. The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations.


We offer
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good career opportunities
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund

The remuneration for Researcher is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1108, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 540.000,- to 590.000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases a higher salary might be considered. As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes availiable. For more information see: spk.no.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics. The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Automasjonsingeniør
description:
Om stillingen

På grunn av økende oppdragsmengde, er vi på jakt etter deg som har erfaring med design av elektriske systemer, styresystemer og programmering/igangkjøring av styresystemer (PLS).

De fleste arbeidsoppgaver utfører vi fra kontorsted. Nordkontakt har kunder over hele landet, så noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk, igangkjøring nye anlegg og serviceoppdrag må påregnes.

Vi har kontorsted i Bodø, men kan også vurdere andre lokasjoner om rette søker dukker opp.

Automasjonsavdelingen vår har i dag 40 ansatte, med en god bredde med tanke på bakgrunn og grunnutdanning. Her kan nevnes ingeniørutdanning/bachelor og master innen automasjon/cybernetikk, elkraft, mekatronikk og datateknikk. I tillegg har flere fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker, maskinist, kjølemontør og lignende som basis før høyere utdanning. En herlig blanding som gjør at vi sammen finner gode løsninger i et bredt spekter av oppdrag. Nordkontakt har som mål å være blant de fremste i bransjen på å teste ut og utvikle nye tekniske løsninger.


Som ingeniør i Nordkontakt

 Får du :

  • Jobbe med spennende kunder
  • Utvikle deg faglig i et sterkt teknisk miljø
  • Være med å teste ut nye systemer og tekniske løsninger
  • Ta et tydelig teknisk ansvar i prosjekter
  • Et spennende fagmiljø innen moderne og avanserte automasjonssystemer
  • Bred teknisk eksponering fra design til ferdig anlegg
  • Et kompetent og uformelt fagmiljø
  • Reell påvirkningsmulighet
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig
  • Korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Prosjektering automasjonsanlegg.

• Programmering styresystemer og sikkerhetssystemer

• Konfigurering/programmering/design HMI og driftskontrollanlegg. Alarmhåndtering, datalogg og rapportering. 

• FAT- og SAT-prosesser - igangsetting nye anlegg

• Dokumentasjon 

• Serviceprosjekter - feilsøking, vedlikehold og ombygging eksisterende anlegg

• Oppsett servere/nettverksutstyr for automasjonsanlegg og driftskontroll

Avhengig av din kunnskap og erfaring, kan det også være aktuelt med arbeidsoppgaver/støttefunksjon opp mot andre funksjoner og fagfelt i bedriften. Våre leveransen stiller store krav til både IT- og OT sikkerhet.


Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har :

Bachelor eller Master innen automasjon, kybernetikk, elektro eller tilsvarende. 

Du kan også ha teknisk fagskole innen elektro/automasjon.

Kan vise til arbeidserfaring fra lignende type arbeid.


Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er systematisk og strukturert.
  • Har lyst å jobbe direkte mot kunder.
  • Er faglig trygg og kunne jobbe selvstendig under tidspress.
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk skriftlig/muntlig.
  • Har mulighet for noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk og igangkjøring av anlegg.
  • Har arbeidserfaring med lignende type arbeid.

Gode grunner til å jobbe i Nordkontakt

Gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss

Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med utfordrende arbeid i en bedrift i vekst. Foruten et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og en stor dose godt humør kan vi også tilby:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med god spredning i alder og kompetanse
  • Stor påvirkningskraft over din egen arbeidshverdag
  • Å delta på våre gøye sosiale tiltak
  • Treningsavtaler
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • En attraktiv bonusavtale

Vår viktigste kapital er våre medarbeidere! Vi setter derfor utvikling og kompetanseheving hos våre ansatte veldig høyt. Det forvalter vi som best vi kan i opplæringsplattformen vår Elektroakademiet. Les mer om hvordan vi legger til rette for at medarbeiderne våre kan søke ny- eller friske opp sin kunnskap via denne linken.


Vi trenger flere kvinner!

Vi og resten av Elektrogruppen anser mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer derfor spesielt kvinner til å søke. Les mer om våre målsettinger og hvordan vi arbeider med å styrke mangfoldet i vår likestillingsredegjørelse.


Vi tar bærekraft på alvor

For oss er bærekraft en del av alt vi gjør. Vi utvikler løsninger som reduserer utslipp og fremmer energieffektivitet, samtidig som vi skaper trygge og gode arbeidsplasser for våre ansatte. Les mer i vår bærekraftsrapport.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordkontakt er en ingeniørbedrift med 105 ansatte som jobber med automasjon, tavleproduksjon, digitalisering, informasjonsteknologi og elektro. Vi har hovedkontor i Bodø, avdelingskontor i Ørsta/Volda og er ledende innfor våre områder med en historikk tilbake til1966.

Vi er i dag en betydelig aktør innenfor automatisering av landbasert settefisk- og oppdrettsanlegg. Vi har også kunder innen slakteri, vei, jernbane, gruvedrift, forskningsfartøy, fiskebåter, bygg, industri, VA-anlegg og energi. Nordkontakt tilbyr også skybaserte tjenester ifm. SD-anlegg (NK-sky) til våre kunder. 

Vi har en stor IT-avdeling som leverer kameraløsninger samt bistår med OT-sikkerheten til våre kunders anlegg. 

Nordkontakt leverer produkter og tjenester på alle nivå i prosessen, fra enkle komponenter til ferdige idriftsatte anlegg. Vi har flere ulike testverksted tilknyttet våre ulike fag. Og om vi ikke har funnet komponenter som dekker kundenes behov, så har vi faktisk bare utviklet disse selv. 

Vårt verdigrunnlag er tuftet på at vi er en bedrift som opptrer Fremtidsrettet Ansvarlig Løsningsorientert og Kompetent. Vi løser våre oppdrag med målsetting om å skape trygghet for våre kunder, så vel som våre medarbeidere og samfunnet vi er en del av, og i Nordkontakt, holder vi det vi lover!

Vi er en del av konsernet Elektrogruppen, en av landets største private tekniske entreprenører med virksomhet fra Trøndelag i sør til Vesterålen i nord.  Samlet er nesten 700 ansatte, fordelt på 15 entreprenører. Effektivt tverrfaglig samarbeid og erfaringsutveksling bedriftene imellom gir positive effekter for våre kunder lokalt.

title: Senior Financial Controller - regnskap og rapportering - Osland AS
description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper, med virksomhet innen genetikk, settefisk og matfiskproduksjon. Vi søker nå en erfaren Senior Financial Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i videreutviklingen av konsernets økonomifunksjon.

 

Rollen er knyttet til Osland AS-delkonsernet, som består av Osland AS og fem datterselskaper, i tillegg til løpende oppfølging av fire produksjonsregnskap. Dette gir et bredt og komplekst økonomisk landskap med behov for god forståelse av sammenhengen mellom selskapsregnskap, produksjon, rapportering og styringsinformasjon. Dette er en bred seniorrolle for deg som har solid regnskapsforståelse, liker å skape struktur og kvalitet, og samtidig motiveres av utvikling, systemer og smartere arbeidsprosesser.

 

Du vil arbeide tett med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller og regnskapsførerne, og få en viktig rolle i å sikre kvalitet i regnskap og rapportering på tvers av selskaper og produksjonsområder.

 

Stillingen spenner fra operative og regnskapsnære oppgaver til rapportering, budsjett, internkontroll, systemutvikling og forbedring av økonomiprosesser. Vi ser derfor etter en erfaren person som trives med bredde og variasjon, og som er komfortabel med at prioriteringene kan variere gjennom året.

Om rollen

Som Senior Financial Controller vil du være en sentral fagressurs i økonomiteamet og bidra til at regnskap, tallgrunnlag og rapportering holder høy kvalitet. Du vil arbeide tett med regnskapsførerne og Business Controller i den månedlige lukkingen av regnskapene, og bidra til gode rutiner, avstemminger, periodiseringer og regnskapsmessige vurderinger. Samtidig vil du ha en viktig rolle innen konsolidering, rapportering, budsjett og prognoser, og være med på å videreutvikle konsernets økonomiske styringsinformasjon.

 

En viktig del av rollen er også løpende arbeid med å styrke internkontroll og strukturkapital. Det innebærer å bidra til tydelige rutiner, dokumenterte arbeidsprosesser, god ansvarsdeling og etterlevelse av etablerte prinsipper og kontrollaktiviteter. Vi arbeider tett med robuste prosesser som er forståelige, etterleves i organisasjonen og er mindre personavhengige.

 

Du vil også bidra til å utvikle måten vi arbeider på gjennom bedre utnyttelse av ERP-system, rapporteringsløsninger, data og automatisering.

 

Rollen passer godt for deg som liker kombinasjonen av regnskap, kvalitet, internkontroll, systemforståelse og utvikling. Dette er en seniorrolle som krever at du arbeider selvstendig, tar eierskap til dine ansvarsområder og selv ser hvor det er behov for oppfølging eller forbedring. Vi ser etter en person som tar initiativ, driver saker fremover og bidrar der behovet er størst.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Delta aktivt i månedlig regnskapsavslutning for selskapene og sikre god kvalitet og fremdrift i closingprosessen
  • Kvalitetssikre regnskap, avstemminger, periodiseringer og vesentlige regnskapsmessige vurderinger
  • Bidra til konsolidering og konsernrapportering
  • Kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle månedlig rapportering og styringsinformasjon
  • Ha en sentral rolle i omfattende budsjett- og prognoseprosesser
  • Følge opp balanse, arbeidskapital, kontantstrøm og grunnlag for likviditetsprognoser
  • Følge opp internprising, internfakturering og konserninterne avregninger
  • Arbeide med verdsettelse og kontroll av beholdning og varelager
  • Delta sentralt i årsoppgjør og revisjon
  • Videreutvikle internkontroll, rutiner, dokumentasjon og kontrollaktiviteter
  • Bidra til at etablerte rutiner, fullmakter og prosesser etterleves i organisasjonen
  • Bygge og vedlikeholde strukturkapital gjennom tydelige arbeidsprosesser, ansvarsdeling og dokumentasjon
  • Redusere personavhengighet og bidra til robuste og skalerbare økonomiprosesser
  • Bidra til videreutvikling og bedre utnyttelse av ERP- og rapporteringssystemer
  • Identifisere muligheter for standardisering, automatisering og effektivisering
  • Bidra i økonomirelaterte utviklingsprosjekter på tvers av konsernet
  • Være en faglig sparringspartner for kollegaer i økonomiteamet
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren og faglig trygg økonom som liker å ta ansvar for at tallene er riktige og prosessene fungerer godt.

 

Du er strukturert og nøyaktig, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert. Du evner å gå ned i detaljene når det er nødvendig, samtidig som du ser helheten og forstår hvordan selskapsregnskap, produksjon, systemer, internkontroll og rapportering henger sammen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:

  • liker en variert arbeidshverdag og et bredt ansvarsområde
  • er selvstendig, initiativrik og komfortabel med å ta faglig ansvar
  • er fleksibel og håndterer både faste prosesser og problemstillinger som oppstår underveis
  • tar eierskap, jobber åpent og følger opp oppgaver til de er løst
  • ser forbedringsbehov og tar initiativ uten å være avhengig av detaljerte bestillinger
  • liker å skape struktur og sikre at avtalte arbeidsmetoder faktisk etterleves
  • har forståelse for betydningen av gode rutiner, dokumentasjon og internkontroll
  • er opptatt av å bygge robuste prosesser som ikke er avhengige av enkeltpersoner
  • er nysgjerrig på systemer og hvordan teknologi kan brukes til å forenkle og forbedre økonomiarbeidet
  • liker kombinasjonen av operative oppgaver og mer langsiktig utviklingsarbeid

Vi ser ikke etter en person som kun ønsker å arbeide med én avgrenset del av økonomifaget. Stillingen har stor bredde og krever at du både kan gå ned i detaljene og løfte blikket, samt bidra der behovet til enhver tid er størst.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap, revisjon eller tilsvarende
  • Flere års relevant erfaring fra regnskap, revisjon, controlling eller finansiell rapportering
  • Solid regnskapsforståelse og erfaring med måneds- og årsavslutning
  • God forståelse for resultat, balanse og kontantstrøm
  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP- og rapporteringssystemer, samt interesse for videre læring
  • Gode Excel-kunnskaper
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Erfaring med konsernregnskap, budsjett og prognose, varelagervurdering, revisjon, internkontroll, Xledger, One Stop Reporting, Power BI, Power Query eller automatisering er en fordel.

 

Det viktigste er at du har et solid faglig fundament, tilstrekkelig erfaring til å ta et selvstendig faglig ansvar og et ønske om å bidra til å bygge en stadig bedre og mer robust økonomifunksjon.

Vi tilbyr
  • En sentral seniorrolle i økonomifunksjonen i et norsk havbrukskonsern
  • Et bredt ansvarsområde på tvers av selskaper, produksjonsområder og økonomiprosesser
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og påvirkningsmulighet
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan økonomiprosesser, internkontroll, systemer og rapportering videreutvikles
  • En sentral rolle i å bygge robuste arbeidsprosesser og strukturkapital i organisasjonen
  • Tett samarbeid med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller, regnskapsførere og ledere i konsernet
  • Moderne systemer og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Mulighet til å kombinere regnskapsfaglig arbeid med system- og prosessutvikling
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Arbeidssted: Sandviken, Bergen

  • Hjemmekontor: Delvis, etter avtale

     

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

title: Green Office - Project Coordinator
description:
About the position 

The UiO Green Office is looking for a student employee to help strengthen sustainability engagement across student life, education, and research at the University of Oslo.

This position is part of two of our working groups; Education & Research and Dissemination & Dialogue work. They work to connect students, student organizations and researchers to strengthen sustainability engagement at UiO.


Qualifications

Previous experience or education related to organizational work or education is an advantage. You must be enrolled as a UiO student throughout 2026 and 2027

Key responsibilities and tasks include:

  • Collaborating with the Student Parliament, student organizations and other sustainability initiatives.
  • Promoting sustainability-related education and research at UiO
  • Contributing to larger events such as the SDG conference, theme weeks and national and international Green Office networks
  • Supporting projects that connect students, faculties, and researchers

Personal skills

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has an interest in sustainability education and research and student engagement
  • Can work independently and take responsibility for projects
  • Enjoys working collaboratively in a team

  • Has strong organizational skills

    It is an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Student organizations, politics (i.e. program committee), volunteer work, or project coordination.
  • Event planning, communication, or outreach activities

We offer 
  • A 20-30% position (depending on your capacity) 
  • Salary NOK 425 000 - per year for a full-time position (pro-rated for 20–30%).
  • Practical experience with sustainability projects and collaboration across the university
  • Practical experience in sustainability and project development
  • An engaging, creative, and supportive work environment
  • Opportunities to shape sustainability initiatives at UiO
  • Valuable experience in teamwork, leadership, and stakeholder collaboration

Inclusive worklife and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position. 


How to apply

Please submit:

  • A CV
  • A short motivation letter (approximately one page)
  • A reference person (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number) is positive, but not a requirement. 

In your motivation letter, we would like you to reflect briefly on:

  • Why would you like to work at the Green Office?
  • How would you engage students and student organizations in sustainability work at UiO?
  • What experience, skills, or interests would you bring to this role?
  • Describe an initiative, project, or collaboration that you are proud of contributing to.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

About the Green Office

The Green Office is UiO's student-driven hub for sustainability initiatives (Green Office - University of Oslo).. We develop projects, events, and collaborations that help make the university more sustainable while creating opportunities for students to get involved. Our team is organized into four working groups that reflect the themes of UiO's Climate and Environmental Strategy (Comprehensive Climate and Environmental Strategy - University of Oslo).

title: Driftsmedarbeider – 100% fast stilling
description:
Vest Bilutleie søker en pålitelig og selvstendig driftsmedarbeider til fast 100% stilling i Herøysund. Stillingen passer for deg som liker en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag, trives med ansvar og har øye for detaljer. Erfaring fra bilbransjen er ikke nødvendig – vi gir opplæring.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser først og fremst etter en person vi kan stole på og gi ansvar.

Du bør være:

  • Pålitelig og punktlig

  • Selvstendig

  • Detaljorientert

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Løsningsorientert

  • Komfortabel med kundekontakt

  • Glad i en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Villig til å lære og utvikle deg

  • En person som tar initiativ når noe må gjøres

Hos oss får du mye tillit, og vi ønsker derfor en medarbeider som ser hva som må gjøres og følger opp oppgavene sine uten at alt må detaljstyres.

title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references 
  • Documentation of English proficiency 

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. We only accept applications and documentation sent via Jobbnorge within the application deadline. The applicant will be assessed by an expert committee. 


We offer
  • Participation in an excellent and thriving research group that has recently received a prestigious ERC Synergy grant (https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/synergy-grants-2023-examples-projects) 
  • A productive, collaborative, and stimulating environment with researchers working on cutting-edge medical applications of artificial intelligence and speech technologies
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement 
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The possibility to balance professional development with a location to experience the liberating arctic nature: ski under the northern lights, hike and bike along the fjords 
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services. 
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details
    regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for
applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.
 

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
 

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility
 

The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1109, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 670000 to 730000 (in a 100% position)  (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.)


A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. As a state employee, you will have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no

Employees who have been temporarily employed at UiT continuously for more than three years shall be deemed to be permanently employed, cf. the Civil Service Act § 9 (3).


According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to
academia, people, and contemporary developments

title: KAPELLAN I TILLER SOKN
description:
Tiller er en bydel sør i Trondheim, med store næringsarealer og en relativt ung befolkning. Syv av ti er medlemmer i Den norske kirke. Kunne du tenke deg å være prest blant dem?

Tiller er både bygd og by, en del av Trondheim, men også et eget lokalsamfunn med et mangfold av butikker, bedrifter og virksomheter. Tiller kirke, fra 1901, ligger vakkert til i bydelen, omgitt av en stor og velstelt kirkegård. Her er en rekke skoler for alle alderstrinn, blant annet Kristen videregående skole Trøndelag. I bydelen finnes også Birgittaklosteret, et buddhistisk tempel, et hindutempel og Jehovas Vitner. I det hele er Tiller en mangfoldig bydel med nesten 15000 innbyggere og mange arenaer for samarbeid og utvikling.

Tiller menighet ønsker å være et felleskap i folkekirken der alle kan føle seg hjemme, og der det er rom for å søke mening og dybde i livet. Det er to prester i en relativt stor stab, med kateket, menighetspedagog, diakon, kantor, daglig leder og kirketjener, som holder til i kontorer på Menighetssenteret sentralt plassert i bydelen. Huset rommer også en åpen barnehage som drives i samarbeid med menigheten. I Tiller tilbys ulike aktiviteter for alle aldersgrupper: gudstjenester, småsprell, tweens, menighetstreff, KFUK-KFUM-speidergruppe, familiemiddag, formiddagstreff, vaffeltorsdag og kirkekor. Det er god oppslutning om dåp og konfirmasjon, med om lag 100 konfirmanter årlig. Den nye kapellanen vil ha et særskilt fokus på menighetens barn og unge. Oppgavene er varierte og du som søker vil få rom til å utforske hvilke av dine kvaliteter som passer best inn i helheten. Det er utstrakt og godt samarbeid i Kirkelig fellesråd i Trondheim og prostiet, på tvers av soknegrenser og bydeler.

Som ny prest blir du også del av et flott arbeidskollegium i Trondheim prosti, som dekker et område med om lag 175.000 av Trondheims innbyggere. Prostiet har 13 sokn og 27 prester. Det betyr et allsidig og robust prestekollegium i ett tjenesteområde, som innbyr til faglig utveksling og gode samarbeidsprosjekter.  I Trondheim har vi by-omfattende tilbud innen retreat, kurs og samtalegrupper og konfirmanttreff mm. Vi har kontekstuelle utviklingsprosjekter som Barnas katedral, U-kirke, Grønn katedral og Frivillighetsprosjekt, som kan inspirere og gi rom for differensierte tjenester som prest i byen.
Prestene har månedlige samlinger, tilbud om ukentlig tekstverksted, og fagdager i byen og bispedømmet. Trondheim er, med Nidarosdomen sentralt plassert, et senter for pilegrimsteologi og forvaltning av Olavsarv og olsokfeiring i Den norske kirke, og den kirkelige aktiviteten er utforskende og variert. Sørsamisk kirkeliv og nasjonaljubileet 2030 er et særlig ansvar i bispedømmet.

For mer informasjon: Se hjemmesidene til Trondheim kirkelige fellesråd, menigheten, Nidaros bispedømme og til Trondheim kommune når det gjelder bydelen.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kapellanen må påregne alle oppgaver i henhold til Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Tjenesten er regulert gjennom arbeidsplaner og samarbeid med andre prester i prostiet.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Søkere må fylle vilkårene i henhold til "Kvalifikasjonskrav for tilsetting som menighetsprest", jfr. § 3 i Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Ved tilsetting blir det tatt forbehold om at den som tilsettes kan fremlegge tilfredsstillende politiattest.
  • Målformen i soknene er bokmål. Søkere må opplyse om de behersker begge målformer.
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker en prest som:

  • vil bidra til gode samarbeidsforhold, trivsel og engasjement
  • vil bygge levende fellesskap rundt gudstjenester og kirkelige aktiviteter
  • ønsker å utforske mulighetene som ligger i møte med menighetens barn og unge
  • har sansen for at det er mange forskjellige arbeidsoppgaver i en menighet. 
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingen er plassert i kode 0922 Kapellan. Lønnsfastsettelse skjer etter dokumentert krav om godskriving av ansiennitet.  
  • Medlemskap i offentlig pensjonsordning (KLP).
  • Bispedømmet har godt utbygde personaltiltak, herunder arbeidsveiledning.
*************************************************
Nidaros bispedømme skal være en arbeidsplass med rom og respekt for mangfold, uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne og legning. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

Tilsetting skjer på de vilkår som til enhver tid gjelder og den som tilsettes må rette seg etter følgende:
a) endring i lover, tariffavtaler, reglement m.v. herunder spørsmål vedrørende tjenesteordning og beredskapsordning.

title: PhD Candidate in International Business
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is at NTNU in Ålesund at the School of International Business. We are looking for candidates with an educational background in international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees, including technology management, innovation management, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management, will also be considered.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a future career in higher education and research, both within and beyond academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, automation, and remote operations are transforming not only where people work, but also how work is organized. As technologies redistribute tasks, expertise, decision-making authority, and responsibility across people and locations, they can reconfigure established roles, relationships, and ways of working. These changes raise important leadership questions: How do leaders help employees navigate changing roles and responsibilities? How are trust, shared understanding, and coordination maintained when work becomes increasingly technology-mediated and geographically distributed? And how do leadership practices emerge as established authority structures are reshaped by technology?

These leadership challenges can become particularly pronounced in culturally diverse teams, where members may differ in their expectations regarding leadership, authority, autonomy, participation, communication, and responsibility. Such differences may reflect both the cultural composition of the team and the cultural values and orientations of individual members. The aim of this PhD project is to investigate how leadership and culture jointly shape responses to technology-driven changes in distributed work, with particular attention to how leaders navigate culturally diverse expectations as new ways of working emerge, and how these processes influence trust, role clarity, and coordination. 

The PhD project seeks to advance research on leadership, cross-cultural management, and technology-driven organizational change, potentially using remote maritime operations as a relevant empirical context in which geographically dispersed and culturally diverse actors must navigate shifting roles and authority while coordinating effectively in a safety-critical environment.

The successful candidate will have scope to develop the theoretical framework, research questions, and methodological design within the project's overall direction.


About the proposal

The PhD candidate should develop and submit a proposal within the scope of the topic, and, if selected as the preferred candidate, conduct research on the topic. Preferably, the PhD candidate’s research should focus on industries relevant to the Møre and Romsdal county, such as the marine and maritime industries.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group on international business and innovation.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have an academically relevant background, preferably within international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees including technology management, management of innovation, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management may also apply. 
  • You must have a master’s degree in international business, international management, business administration, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course in which 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may still be considered if you can demonstrate that you are particularly well-suited for a PhD program.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty of economics and management doctoral programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/ok/research/phd)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English and/or Norwegian.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good knowledge of industries represented in the region, such as the marine, maritime and furniture industry, both local and global.
  • Have strong motivation for advanced research work demonstrated by a motivation letter and a proposal within the scope of the project description above.
  • Good demonstrated theoretical and analytical skills.
  • Contribute to a positive work environment in general is emphasized.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 2000 words/5 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc., other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Possible letter(s) of reference/recommendation
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact the Head of Department, Associate Professor Mark Pasquine (mapa@ntnu.no), Professor Ghulam Mustafa (guma@ntnu.no), or the Deputy leader, Research & Innovation, Professor Richard Glavee-Geo (rigl@ntnu.no). If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Adviser Oddny Lyngvær at email: oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no or telephone: +47 95011957. 

Application deadline: 25.10.2026

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
employer: OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS HF BEDRIFTSHELSETJENESTE OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no
