title: Psykisk helse og rus
employer: ØYGARDEN KOMMUNE RUS OG PSYKISK HELSE SONE STRAUME
description:
Om avdelinga

Tunet er eit døgnbemanna butilbod for vaksne med samansette utfordringar knytte til rus og psykisk helse. Vi arbeider for å skapa ein trygg, føreseieleg og meiningsfull kvardag for bebuarane våre, med vekt på relasjonsbygging, meistring, medverknad og respekt. Vi tilbyr individuelt tilpassa tenester og arbeider målretta for å styrkja ressursane og moglegheitene til kvar enkelt. Dette krev tett oppfølging, fagleg refleksjon og godt samarbeid både internt og med pårørande og andre samarbeidspartnarar. Vi har ei personalgruppe med høg fagleg kompetanse og relevant høgskuleutdanning innan helse- og sosialfag. Vi arbeider tett saman i team og samarbeider med pårørande og andre faginstansar for å gi brukarane trygge og heilskaplege tenester.

Vi ønskjer å vera ein arbeidsplass prega av openheit, engasjement og fagleg utvikling, der medarbeidarane støttar kvarandre og arbeider mot felles mål.

Vi har nå ledig 100% vikariat ved Tunet

Vikariatet er ledig frå 01.01.2027 til 31.10.2027

Stillinga har ei gjennomsnittleg arbeidstid på 35,5 timar per veke over ein periode på 52 veker. Tenestene er utforma med utgangspunkt i brukarane sitt behov for kontinuitet, tryggleik og føreseielegheit.

For tida er arbeidet organisert i døgn-/medleverturnus. Medarbeidarane arbeider i samanhengande arbeidsperiodar på 2 til 3 døgn, etterfølgt av friperiodar. Turnusordninga legg til rette for stabile relasjonar, tett oppfølging og god kontinuitet i tenestene.

Arbeidstidsordninga er etablert for å møta behova i tenesta og kan endrast dersom behova til brukarane eller andre rammevilkår tilseier det.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Gje oppfølging og miljøterapeutisk bistand til brukarane i tråd med vedtak, mål og individuelle behov, og bidra til meistring, sjølvstende og livskvalitet.
  • Byggja trygge relasjonar og leggja til rette for ein stabil og føreseieleg kvardag.
  • Administrera legemiddel samt dokumentera, evaluera og følgja opp tiltak i elektronisk pasientjournal.
  • Arbeida i tråd med gjeldande lovverk, faglege retningslinjer og vedtekne rutinar.
  • Samarbeida med pårørande og relevante samarbeidspartnarar.
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetsarbeid og eit godt arbeidsmiljø.
KvalifikasjonarMå ha
  • Bachelor i vernepleie eller sjukepleie med vidareutdanning innan psykisk helse- og rusarbeid.
  • Relevant erfaring frå arbeid innan rus og psykisk helse, med vekt på miljøterapeutisk arbeid, relasjonsbygging og legemiddelbehandling.
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både munnleg og skriftleg.
  • Førarkort klasse B.
Ønskjelege kvalifikasjonar
  • Erfaring frå døgnbemanna tenester.
  • Kunnskap om recovery-orientert arbeid.
  • Kunnskap om traumeinformert praksis.
  • Erfaring med dokumentasjon i elektroniske journalsystem.
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er trygg, robust og bevarer ro og fagleg vurderingsevne i krevjande situasjonar.
  • Har gode relasjonelle ferdigheiter og evne til å skapa tillit over tid.
  • Er fleksibel, løysingsorientert og tek ansvar.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og trivst med å arbeida tett saman med kollegaar og samarbeidspartnarar.
  • Bidreg aktivt til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og fagleg utvikling.

Vi legg stor vekt på personlege eigenskapar og evna til samarbeid.

Anna

Gyldig politiattest må leggjast fram før tilsetjing.

Vi tilbyr:
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
  • Ein spennande arbeidsplass med godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Motiverte og kunnskapsrike kollegaer
  • Interessante utfordringar
  • Høve til fagleg og personleg utvikling
  • Vi tilbyr startlån for å rekruttere og behalde helsepersonell. Sjå kommunens heimeside for meir informasjon om Startlån 
Kontakt:

Avdelingsleiar: Rikke Etim tlf: 488 96 196

Rikke.etim@oygarden.kommune.no

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Active ageing and the built environment
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

     

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you ready to take your research career to the next level? Are you interested in how our built environment shapes and conditions our physical activity and quality of life? How this interacts with an ageing society and the possibilities for all to stay active and healthy? And how urban planning may support active ageing? And do you have strong competencies in quantitative research in the built environment and active travel/physical activity or public health? 

At NTNU's Department of Architecture and Planning (IAP), we offer an exciting 3-year postdoctoral position that gives you the opportunity to develop a strong profile as a researcher. The position is closely related to NTNU's community's interdisciplinary research team on active aging as well as the department’s research focus on the built environment and urban planning. You will gain valuable experience that may be relevant to your future career. The purpose of a postdoctoral position is to build up a researcher profile that qualifies for a position as an associate professor. The position may also offer additional skills that are relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

At the Department of Architecture and Planning in Trondheim, we focus on research and education in architecture, urban planning, smart cities, and property development, including the societal consequences of features and developments in the built environment.

Apply for this position to become part of our research environment and take the next step in your career with us.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project 

The Department of Architecture and Planning invites applications for a position as a Postdoctoral Fellow in Active ageing and the built environment. The position is funded by NTNU Community in connection with Team Active Ageing. The work will address the environmental determinants of physical activity, walking and quality of life among older adults in Norwegian rural and urban areas. The Postdoc will rely on a combination of micro-level health survey data (HUNT) and geo-spatial data to measure and assess the relevant characteristics of the environment (e.g. based on concepts such as walkability). The Postdoctoral Fellow will work with the interplay between architecture, planning, psychology, and public health. Key research questions will be:

  • How can high-resolution geographic information system (GIS) data and data from The Trøndelag Health Study (HUNT) be combined to study environmental physical activity, walking behavior, and quality of life?
  • How do built environment characteristics influence physical activity, walking behavior, and quality of life among older adults?
  • How does the built environment condition change in walking and cognitive health in a cohort of older adults?
  • What are the societal challenges and potentially actionable insights from the perspective of built environment influences on Active ageing?

Duties of the position
  • Carry out research of good quality 
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination incl. collaboration with the supervisory team to co-author at least 3-4 publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Conduct independent and collaborative research focused on Active ageing and built environment with a focus on the role of urban planning as enabler of activity and quality of life in old age.
  • Participate in activities of the department’s research group on Urban planning.
  • Collaborate with urban planners, psychologists, public health professionals, and stakeholders, e.g. from Team Active ageing, HUNT, Trondheim Municipality, Trøndelag county authority and other partners in Norway and Europe.
  • Follow up administrative requirements bound to the project and position.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions 
  • Apply for research funding and write applications and report on progress to funding sources 
  • Teaching 
  • Mentoring students, helping them with their research projects, and advising on methodology and academic writing 

Required selection criteria
  • You must have completed a doctoral degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. 
  • If you are in the final phase of your doctorate and can document that the thesis has been submitted or that the defense date has been confirmed, your application can be considered even if you have not defended. NOTE: Documentation of the obtained doctorate must be presented before you can take up the position. 
  • A proven track record from research related to active travel/physical activity, public health and built environment. 
  • Experience working with geo-spatial data and derived built environment metrics such as walkability.
  • Experience with quantitative analysis focused on behavior or health outcomes. 
  • Experience in publishing interdisciplinary and applied research.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. This can be done through an approved English language test. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills, as well as the ability to communicate fluently, will be conducted throughout the selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

If you do not already have educational competence that meets the requirements for a position as associate professor in Norway, NTNU will arrange for you to acquire such competence during the employment period. In such cases, you will also be assigned relevant teaching as part of the career-promoting work.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience from interdisciplinary work in between architecture, urban planning, social sciences and public health.
  • A record of peer-reviewed publications in relevant fields
  • Experience in applying for research funding or contributing to grant proposals
  • Experience from coordinating with stakeholders or external partners
  • Experience in teaching and supervision of master theses or student research projects
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish), both written and spoken, at B2 level or higher is considered an advantage. 

Personal characteristics

Working as a postdoctoral fellow requires that you be able to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in your work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in your research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities


We offer 
  • An exciting job with an important social mission 
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment 
  • Career guidance throughout the postdoctoral program and together with you we will prepare a career plan, which contains the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues 
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU 
  • Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a Postdoctoral Fellow at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem-solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU, we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have several measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

As a Postdoctoral Fellow (code 1352) you are normally paid from gross NOK 633 400,- per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.


The period of employment is 3 years (including career promotion work/ teaching duties).

The position is conditional on funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and to adapt to them. 

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. 

The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant describes personal motivation and relevance with respect to the requirements of this advertisement (maximum 1 page).
  • CV based on the Norwegian Research Councils template for early career researchers (https://www.forskningsradet.no/siteassets/utlysninger/vedlegg-utlysninger/template-for-cv-early-career-scientists.docx ) including experiences/contributions to relevant projects, funding applications and collaboration with partners and stakeholders (In Project Management experiences or early track record as applicable). 
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's-, Master's- and PhD degrees. If you have not yet completed your PhD, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the doctoral dissertation, or confirmation that your PhD thesis has been submitted. Documentation of a completed doctoral degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of relevant research questions, theoretical perspectives and methodological design (maximum 3 pages and 1800 words). This proposal will be neither final nor binding for the project.
  • A copy of the doctoral thesis. If you are close to submitting, you can attach a draft of the thesis.
  • Academic works - published or unpublished - that you would like to be considered in the assessment (up to 5 items).
  • Possible recommendation letters
  • You are encouraged to include documentation of English language proficiency if you are not a native speaker of English. 
  • Name and contact information of three referees.

If all or parts of your education have been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education. Description of the documentation requiredcan be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint works will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint works, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

If you have had leave or another break in your career, it is important that this is stated in your application so that the selection committee can take this into account and that the amount of your research may be reduced as a result.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal qualities. Motivation, ambitions and potential for research will also be emphasized in the assessment of the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and is committed to follow evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment DORA and the obligations in CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information 

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public list of applicants, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Thomas Sick Nielsen by email at thomas.s.nielsen@ntnu.no 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Sven Robert Storø by email at sven.r.storo@ntnu.no.

If you find this position interesting, and in accordance with your qualifications, please submit your application electronically via jobbnorge.no with your CV, diplomas and certificates attached. 

 

Application deadline: 19.10.2026

employer: TROMSØ KOMMUNE KOORDINERENDE HELSE- OG OMSORGSTJENESTER
description:
Bli en del av et fagmiljø som setter mennesker først!

Lanterna oppfølgingstjeneste som er en del av Enhet for psykisk helse og rus i Tromsø kommune ser etter fleksible og trygge tilkallingsvikarer. Vi har behov for vikarer til turnus, og særlig deg som kan jobbe dagvakter.

Hos oss får du være med på å skape mestring og livskvalitet.
Vi tilbyr oppfølging til innbyggere med psykisk helse- og rusutfordringer, gjennom psykisk helsehjelp, motiverende samtaler og hjemmebaserte tjenester. Oppfølgingen er recoveryorientert, og vi tar alltid utgangspunkt i det som er viktig for den enkelte. Sammen jobber vi for økt selvstendighet, mestring og en meningsfull hverdag.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Oppfølging og miljøarbeid for personer med utfordringer knyttet til psykisk helse og rus
  • Gjennomføre motiverende samtaler og bidra til økt mestring, selvstendighet og livskvalitet
  • Bistå brukere i daglige gjøremål, praktiske oppgaver og meningsfulle aktiviteter
  • Legemiddelhåndtering og utdeling av medisiner i henhold til gjeldende rutiner
  • Observere, kartlegge og dokumentere brukerens behov og utvikling
  • Bidra til å skape trygghet, struktur og forutsigbarhet i brukernes hverdag
  • Delta i utarbeidelse og oppfølging av mål og tiltak i samarbeid med bruker
  • Samarbeide tett med kollegaer og øvrige tjenester innen psykisk helse og rus
  • Delta i tverrfaglig samarbeid med spesialisthelsetjenesten, fastleger, Boligkontoret og andre aktuelle samarbeidspartnere
  • Bidra til faglig utvikling og kvalitet i tjenestetilbudet
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant helsefaglig kompetanse (studenter oppfordres også til å søke)
  • Erfaring fra psykisk helse- og rusfeltet er en fordel.
  • God norsk muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne. For utenlandske søkere kreves det avlagt språkprøve B2, gjelder ikke skandinaviske land
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er trygg på deg selv, kommuniserer tydelig og bygger gode relasjoner til mennesker rundt deg
  • Du er faglig engasjert og trives med å arbeide både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Du er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig i en variert arbeidshverdag
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med målgruppen er en fordel
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt
Vi tilbyr
  • Opplæring og nødvendige kurs for å kunne utføre arbeidet
  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med dyktige arbeidskolleger
  • En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag
  • Utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver innenfor fagfeltet psykisk helse og rusarbeid
  • Mulighet til å få jobberfaring innenfor psykisk helse og rus

  • Ved tilsetting kreves tuberkuloseundersøkelse for søkere som i løpet av de siste tre årene har oppholdt seg sammenhengende mer enn tre måneder i land

Tromsø kommune er Nord-Norges mest folkerike kommune med 78 000 innbyggere. title: BPA-assistent søkes – for deg som er rolig, selvstendig og omsorgsfull
description:
Jeg ser etter en BPA-assistent som kan bli en viktig del av hverdagen min – en person som liker rolige omgivelser, faste rutiner og det å bidra til at dagene flyter godt. 

Hos meg handler det ikke om stress og høyt tempo, men om tilstedeværelse, struktur og de små tingene som gjør hverdagen god. Kanskje du trives med å ha oversikt, gjøre oppgaver med omtanke, og skape ro rundt deg? Da kan dette være en jobb for deg. 

Hvordan hverdagen hos meg ser ut: 

Dagene består av praktiske og rolige oppgaver i hjemmet. Det kan for eksempel være å handle etter liste, gjøre klart til middag, vaske klær, skifte sengetøy og utføre andre små og store oppgaver i hjemmet. 

Det er viktig for meg at oppgaver utføres rolig og med omtanke. Jeg setter pris på en assistent som er hensynsfull i måten ting gjøres på, for eksempel ved å lukke dører forsiktig, legge ting pent på plass og bidra til et jevnt og behagelig tempo i hverdagen. Dette er med på å skape trivsel og gode rammer rundt dagen min. 

 

Dette vil du hjelpe meg med: 

Handle dagligvarer 

Forberede enkle måltider 

Holde orden i hjemmet 

Organisering og rydding 

Klesvask og alt som følger med det 

Pakke til helgeturer og utflukter 

Hvem jeg håper du er: 

Du er selvstendig og tar initiativ 

Du liker å jobbe rolig og strukturert 

Du er hensynsfull og har øye for detaljer 

Du har godt humør 

Du trives med orden og gode rutiner 

Hos meg får du: 

En rolig og forutsigbar arbeidshverdag 

Tydelige oppgaver og gode rutiner 

En jobb der du gjør en forskjell 

Stilling og arbeidstid: 

Tilkallingsassistent 

Arbeid på hverdager (dag og kveld) og helger 

Sovende nattevakter kan forekomme 

Reise og utflukter etter avtale 

Lønn og vilkår: 

Lønn etter gjeldende tariff (Landsoverenskomst for BPA) 

Pensjons- og forsikringsordninger 

 

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper jeg du sender en søknad og forteller litt om deg selv.

title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig – Krakau, Polen (Key-Account-Manager/in)
description:
As a Business Development Representative with German-English working Hybrid in Krakow, Poland, you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC

Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in Poland says it all!

What You'll be Doing

Looking to build long term relationships as a trusted advisor? Do you have a passion to maximize sales opportunities over the long term? You'll deliver amazing customer service and uncover sales opportunities for our technology client's customers. With a consultative selling approach and focus on revenue targets, you'll cultivate existing customer relationships while establishing and maintaining long-term relationships. You'll work both independently and collaboratively with a cross-functional team to identify and solve business technology needs in a cloud-based environment.

You'll report to the Operations Sales Manager. You’ll contribute to the success of the customer experience as well as the overall success of the team.

During a Typical Day, You'll

- Bring your passion to negotiate with brand knowledge to close a sale, handle objections and rebuttals during customer interactions
- Recommend, quote, and negotiate product knowledge with customers to close the sale while identifying and handling all sales opportunities
- Build a healthy sales pipeline to achieve main targets
- Support customers ranging from small to medium size businesses or advertising agencies and C-Level business contacts supporting cloud-based technology
- Bring your curiosity to stay on top of the trends in the technology industry

What You Bring to the Role

- Experience prospecting, developing accounts, negotiating, and closing deals
- Develop partnerships and communicate with high-level decision makers to assess needs
- Some understanding of cloud-based software
- Verbal and written proficiency in both German (minimum B2+/C1 level) and English (minimum B2 level)
- 1+ years demonstrated sales experience
- A solution-oriented mindset and comfortable working to resolve issues before escalating to the next level
- Reside in or able to relocate to the Krakow area

What You Can Expect

- Generous relocation package of 10.000 PLN gross
- Base salary of 11.000 PLN plus performance-related bonuses opportunities
- MyBenefit - Kafeteria
- PPK Plan
- Employee Referral program
- VISA and Work Permit reimbursement if needed
- Additional days of annual leave
- Private Luxmed medical care including dental care and eye care plan (glasses reimbursement)
- Multisport Card
- Flexible working hours and additional days of annual leave
- Partial language course reimbursement program as well as tuition program for sales courses and studies

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

- Ability to multitask and remain organized in a fast-paced environment

The Offer

- Office-based position in Lisbon, Portugal
- Comprehensive paid onboarding and product training
- Relocation support, including accommodation for candidates moving from abroad
- Private health insurance from the first day of employment
- Meal allowance
- Stable full-time employment with rotating weekday shifts
- International and multicultural working environment
- Career development opportunities within a global organization
- Modern office facilities and ongoing learning programs
- Opportunity to turn your passion for gaming into an exciting international career

title: Digital Marketing Specialist i Lissabon Portugal
description:
Er du passioneret omkring digital markedsføring og har erfaring med at optimere online kampagner? Vi leder efter en dygtig og analytisk Digital Marketing Specialist til at blive en del af vores internationale team i Lissabon!

Dine ansvarsområder vil inkludere:

  • Implementere optimeringsløsninger og strategier for vores højværdi-kunder.

  • Annoncering på sociale medier, primært via Google Ads.

  • Udarbejdelse af keyword-pakker, budstrategier og budgetforslag.

  • Udvikle ekspertise i Googles produkter ved hjælp af optimeringsteknikker, herunder Google Search Network (GSN), Mobile og YouTube.

  • Analysere data og tendenser for at skabe meningsfulde indsigter og rapportere på centrale KPI’er.

Vi søger dig, som har:

  • Minimum 12 måneders erfaring med annonceringsoptimering (Google Ads foretrækkes, men erfaring med Meta Ads, Instagram Ads og LinkedIn Ads er også relevant).

  • En struktureret tilgang, stærke analytiske evner og lyst til at arbejde i et internationalt miljø.

  • Gode kommunikationsevner på engelsk (skriftligt og mundtligt).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Hybrid arbejdsmodel (2 dage om ugen på kontoret).

  • Kontor i det kreative og moderne LACS Anjos i Lissabon.

  • Relocation-pakke og støtte til at få NIF og NISS (for kandidater der flytter til Portugal).

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring, inkl. tandlæge- og familieplan.

  • Livsforsikring.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, fællesskab og innovation vægtes højt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Send din ansøgning og CV til LB@jobsqd.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
In this role, you will:
Provide technical guidance to Network Provisioning specialists and support them with complex or non-standard tasks.
Review network configurations, technical instructions, and planned infrastructure changes.
Configure and provision network equipment, including Juniper, Brocade, and Extreme Networks devices.
Coordinate network installations, replacements, upgrades, and maintenance activities across multiple data centres.
Prepare clear technical assignments for on-site engineers performing physical work with network equipment.
Plan network changes, assess associated risks, and define verification and rollback procedures.
Troubleshoot provisioning-related problems and act as an escalation point for difficult technical cases.
Ensure that network changes are completed accurately and in accordance with internal standards.
Cooperate with Network Engineering and Network Operations teams on infrastructure expansion and improvement projects.
Communicate with data-centre representatives, carriers, and other service providers regarding technical and operational matters.
Maintain and improve provisioning procedures, configuration templates, technical documentation, and knowledge base materials.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive provisioning activities and reduce the risk of manual errors.
Participate in testing new network equipment, technologies, tools, and automated workflows.
Mentor team members, share technical knowledge, and support their professional development.
Contribute to workload planning and the continuous improvement of the team’s processes and service quality.

Requirements:
At least three years of professional experience in network engineering, network provisioning, telecommunications, or data-centre networking.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Good knowledge of Layer 2 technologies, including VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience planning and implementing network changes in a production environment.
Ability to diagnose network issues and make sound technical decisions.
Experience preparing technical documentation and instructions for engineers.
Ability to review the work of other specialists and provide constructive technical feedback.
Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a structured approach to work.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Written and spoken English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Practical experience with Juniper, Brocade, or Extreme Networks equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, MPLS, or data-centre fabric technologies.
Experience with network automation tools, Python, Ansible, APIs, or Git.
Familiarity with monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Experience working in the hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre industry.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
About the position

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support and develop our network infrastructure across several data centres.
You will be involved in the daily operation of the network, the investigation of connectivity issues, and the implementation of infrastructure changes. The role also includes participation in projects related to network expansion, new site connectivity, equipment deployment, and automation.

What you will do:
Operate and maintain networking equipment located in multiple data centres.
Configure network devices and monitor the availability and performance of network services.
Perform planned maintenance and take part in resolving emergency situations.
Investigate connectivity problems and other network-related incidents.
Handle requests submitted by customers and internal departments.
Work with other technical teams to implement network changes and improvements.
Participate in expanding the existing network and connecting new locations.
Assist with the selection, testing, and deployment of new networking equipment.
Contribute to the automation of routine network operations.
Create and update technical documentation.

What we are looking for:
Confident understanding of LAN and WAN fundamentals.
Good knowledge of routing technologies and dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Understanding of Layer 2 technologies, including VLANs, xSTP, and LACP.
Familiarity with network availability and redundancy mechanisms such as VRRP and link aggregation.
Ability to diagnose common network issues and perform initial troubleshooting.
English at Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for working with technical documentation and communicating with customers.
Ability to learn new technologies and process a significant amount of technical information in English.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Analytical thinking and a responsible approach to technical tasks.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer to operate and develop our network infrastructure across multiple data centres.

Responsibilities
Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment.
Troubleshoot network incidents and connectivity issues.
Perform planned maintenance and participate in emergency recovery.
Handle technical requests from customers and internal teams.
Support network expansion, new location deployments, and automation projects.
Maintain network documentation and configuration records.
Requirements
At least three years of relevant networking experience.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN technologies.
Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and network redundancy.
Ability to diagnose routing, switching, latency, and packet-loss issues.
Experience configuring network equipment through CLI.
English at Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.
Familiarity with Python, Ansible, APIs, or other automation tools.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
Main responsibilities
Handle complex customer requests through the ticketing system and live chat in Russian and English.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, refunds, credits, service charges, and account balances.
Prepare contracts and coordinate the signing process with customers and internal stakeholders.
Work with internal billing and invoicing platforms, CRM, and other operational systems.
Verify the accuracy of customer, contractual, and billing information.
Coordinate complex cases with Finance, Sales, Account Management, Support, and other departments.
Manage escalations and ensure that customers receive clear, accurate, and timely responses.
Identify recurring billing issues and suggest improvements to internal processes.
Support and mentor less experienced Billing Support Specialists.
Prepare and update instructions for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases.
Participate in testing changes to billing systems and related workflows.
Maintain a high standard of data confidentiality and accuracy.

Our expectations
At least four years of relevant experience in billing support, financial operations, accounts receivable, subscription services, or B2B customer support.
Proven experience independently handling complex billing enquiries, complaints, and escalations.
Good understanding of invoicing, payments, refunds, credit notes, account balances, and reconciliation processes.
Experience preparing, reviewing, or coordinating commercial contracts and related customer documentation.
Confident user of billing platforms, CRM systems, ticketing tools, and invoicing software.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filters, lookups, and pivot tables.
Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with financial and contractual information.
Ability to prioritize a significant workload and take ownership of cases through to their complete resolution.
Experience coordinating issues with Finance, Sales, Legal, Account Management, and technical departments.
Ability to explain complex billing matters clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.
Strong business correspondence and customer-communication skills.
Fluency in written and spoken Russian.
English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for meetings, negotiations, and professional correspondence with international customers.
Ability to mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and contribute to process improvement.
Interest in technology and the ability to understand technically complex products and services.

Would be a plus
Experience in the hosting, cloud, telecommunications, SaaS, or other subscription-based industry.
Knowledge of recurring, usage-based, and multi-currency billing models.
Experience working with payment providers, failed transactions, chargebacks, or payment disputes.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;

CDI à temps plein de droit espagnol ;

Formation lors de la prise de poste ;

Perspectives d'évolution interne ;

Environnement international et multiculturel.

Une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle ;

Un environnement de travail convivial ;

Des avantages complémentaires selon l'entreprise partenaire.

Colybry accompagne gratuitement les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites

- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location
