title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time.

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: HSE Engineer, Customer Projects and Sites
description:
Are you the enthusiastic, self-driven and result-oriented service professional who wants to move our customer’s performance forward by Leading the way?

We are looking for an HSE Engineer to be based in Gothenburg, Karlstad or Sundsvall. As an HSE Engineer you will have an opportunity to secure health, safety, environmental and social responsibility implementation and development of our Global Customer projects and construction sites around the world. We are seeking a dynamic team player to join our team.  

Key responsibilities:

    Provide project HSE engineer services in nominated EPC and high-risk EPS sales and delivery projects, including readiness for ad hoc and pre-planned site presence typically 1 to 4 weeks.
    Provide on-site safety supervisor services in nominated large shutdown work and short projects.
    Train and coach Valmet project and site organizations, including partners contracted as supervisors for site work, on Valmet project and site HSE management and social responsibility process and practices.
    Identify and coordinate the HSE partner network.
    Arrange sub-contractor HSE Days.
    Participate in sub-contractor audits and lead site HSE audits.
    Ensure HSE incidents on customer sites are investigated and communicated and lead serious incident investigations.
    Contribute to developing Valmet project and site HSE management and social responsibility process and practices.

To succeed in this role, you will need:  

    Minimum 5-7 years of experience working in HSE and several years of experience in multi-cultural customer projects and site HSE work.
    Experience in leading complex, cross-functional projects in a global environment.
    Technical competence in customer site HSE management practices including risk identification and mitigation, especially in EPC projects.
    Relevant academic degree, for example in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or other scientific fields. Professional HSE qualifications such as NEBOSH, CSP, or similar will be considered an asset.
    Incident investigation skills.
    Knowledge of multi-site ISO 14001, 45001 and 9001 management system standards, as well as internal auditing skills.
    Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English and Swedish. Knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
    Working knowledge of Microsoft Office-Suite, Power BI, M-Files, Sharepoint and Teams.

You are an HSE role model with integrity and a strong moral compass, which is the fundament of the position. We are looking for a person with a positive and energetic service mindset who can communicate transparently with clarity and authority. You are a person who influences and negotiates to find solutions and achieve results. At the same time, you build strong networks and engagement towards priorities. You have strong decision-making skills and can make the right decisions at the right time.

We offer

In return, we offer you an interesting work environment and a challenging position within a global industry leader, supported by Valmet's global network. With us, you will work in a team that contributes to the success of the organization, as well as find opportunities for personal development.  

Additional information

To be included in the recruiting process, please complete our online application form as soon as possible but no later than October 19, 2026.

Do you want to know more? For further information about the position, please contact Stefan Hallgren, Manager, Customer Projects and Sites HSE, +46725641403.  

For further information regarding the recruitment process, please contact Isabelle Lindow, Talent Acquisition Partner, at isabelle.lindow@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

title: Digitalization Lead
description:
Company description:





Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

Job description:





The role



Our digitalization journey is transforming how we develop the competence of our co-workers, how we work internally, and how we interact with dealers across Europe and customers worldwide. As Digitalization Lead, you will set direction, build alignment and accelerate the delivery of digital improvements that create measurable business value.



You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on delivery. You will challenge existing ways of working, translate complex business needs into clear digital priorities, and lead cross-functional collaboration from opportunity identification through implementation, adoption and value realization.







You will be located in Gothenburg, Sweden and report to Head of Service Operations Development.







What you will do




    

Own and lead the digitalization roadmap for Service Operations Ghent & EU, governing priorities and execution in line with our strategic ambitions for 2030,

  
    

Provide direction and thought leadership on digitalization, advising stakeholders on where technology can create the greatest business value and ensuring that initiatives support strategic objectives.

  
    

Turn business needs into scalable digital opportunities by clarifying problems, scope, users, expected outcomes, dependencies, risks and value, and by guiding solution choices.

  
    

Lead and facilitate digitalization networks and communities of practice across functions and locations. Set purpose and agenda, connect experts and stakeholders, enable knowledge sharing, align priorities and drive joint actions to completion.

  
    

Build strong cross-functional partnerships across business stakeholders, Digitalization & IT, developers, data teams, automation teams and relevant Group functions.

  
    

Build and govern a structured digitalization portfolio and pipeline, creating transparency of requests, initiatives, priorities, ownership, resources, dependencies, benefits and status.

  
    

Explore, evaluate and apply technologies such as automation, data analytics, AI and machine learning, dashboards, applications and emerging digital capabilities.

  
    

Guide the development and continuous improvement of digital solutions using technologies such as Python, Power BI, Databricks, Power Platform and automation tools, including testing, validation and implementation follow-up.

  
    

Drive process standardization, automation and smarter ways of working through RPA, AI solutions and orchestration of digital assets.

  
    

Enable access to the right data through collaboration with Digitalization & IT within SO&T and at Group level, while promoting sound data governance and responsible use of technology.

  
    

Lead change and adoption by building engagement, strengthening digital capability and supporting leaders and teams in embedding new solutions and ways of working.

  
    

Communicate roadmap priorities, progress, business value, risks and decisions through clear executive-level presentations, status updates and visualizations.

  



  



Ready for the next move?



We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via email. Last application 15th of October.

Profile description:

Who you are



You are a lead digitalization professional who combines strategic perspective, business acumen and technical understanding. You are comfortable taking ownership in an evolving environment, creating structures where it is needed and influencing decisions across organizational boundaries.







You bring people together around a shared direction and turn ideas into coordinated action. You communicate with clarity, build trust with senior and operational stakeholders, and balance ambition with pragmatic delivery. You are curious, inclusive and committed to enabling others to succeed.







Required knowledge and experience




    

An MSc in Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Management or Logistics, or equivalent knowledge gained through proven experience.

  
    

Significant experience leading digitalization, business transformation, process improvement or technology-enabled change in a complex organization.

  
    

Proven ability to shape roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, establish governance and lead cross-functional delivery from idea to adoption and value realization.

title: Master Thesis: Productivity Enhancement of PBF-EB Through Porous Printing,
description:
Project Description
Powder Bed Fusion by Electron Beam (PBF-EB) normally aims to produce components with high density. However, productivity may be improved by creating only a gas-tight outer shell around a sintered or semi-melted porous core, followed by Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP). In PBF-EB, internal pores are formed under vacuum, which is favorable for pore closure during HIP provided that the shell remains gas-tight. Previous studies in both PBF-EB and PBF-LB have demonstrated the feasibility of shell-core concepts, although validation for more complex geometries remains limited.[1]­,[2] If HIP is already required, the approach reduces energy input, build time, cost, and evaporation of sensitive alloying elements. The key challenges are to identify stable process parameters, verify shell integrity, and quantify porosity, densification, and dimensional shrinkage.
  
This master thesis will focus primarily on experimental work in the PBF-EB printer. The student will evaluate a limited set of process parameters to produce test parts with a dense shell and a porous sintered or semi-melted core. Samples will be characterized before and after HIP to determine process stability, shell integrity, density, pore morphology, microstructure, and dimensional change. The work will generate an initial dataset for shrinkage compensation and include a limited finite element modelling (FEM) task to predict and compensate shrinkage.
  
The aim is to determine whether a shell-core PBF-EB strategy can shorten build time while producing preforms suitable for HIP consolidation, and to establish an initial method for compensating predictable shrinkage. The scope is sized for one 30-credit master thesis: one material, simple coupon geometries, a few iterative test prints, 1-2 HIP cycles, basic sample characterization, FEM shrinkage modelling, and printing a more complex shape to evaluate the developed model and process parameters. Full constitutive model development, extensive mechanical qualification, and industrial-scale validation are outside the thesis scope.

Scope and Objectives
The student will:

    Review PBF-EB shell-core strategies, HIP densification, shrinkage compensation and relevant FEM approaches.
    Define a feasible specimen design with an airtight shell and a sintered and/or semi-melted core.
    Screen a small set of printer variables.
    Produce a dense reference condition and a number of shell-core conditions with varying initial density levels.
    Characterise shell integrity, density, pore morphology, dimensions, and microstructure before HIP.
    HIP and quantify densification and dimensional shrinkage.
    Create an initial shrinkage-compensation relationship based on FEM modelling.
    Estimate potential build-time and cost benefits relative to the dense reference using recorded machine data.

Expected outcomes

    A documented PBF-EB process window for manufacturing airtight shell-core structures with porous interiors.
    A dataset containing process parameters, density measurements, pore characteristics, shell integrity assessments, 3D scan dimensional measurements before and after HIP.
    Quantification of HIP-induced densification, shrinkage, and geometric deviation for selected shell-core conditions.
    A simplified FEM-based workflow for shrinkage prediction calibrated using experimental results.
    Validation of the methodology on a more complex geometry representative of practical applications.
    An optional comparison between PBF-EB and PBF-LB shell-core structures.
    An indicative assessment of productivity and cost benefits compared with conventional dense PBF-EB manufacturing.
    Recommendations for future work involving more complex geometries, wider process windows, and more advanced modelling approaches.

The student will refine the experimental matrix and FEM together with supervisors and colleagues at Swerim. A successful thesis is expected to prioritize robust PBF-EB processing, verification of shell airtightness, reliable HIP densification, and accurate shrinkage measurements. The FEM work will focus on practical shrinkage prediction and model calibration. Comparison with PBF-LB material is considered a stretch objective and will be included only if resources and project timing permit.

Qualifications
Master’s student in materials science, mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field. A strong understanding of physical metallurgy and an interest in hands-on experimental work, systematic data analysis, and problem-solving are essential. Access to FEM software such as Abaqus or COMSOL through the university is required because Swerim has limited number of software licenses. Practical experience with metal powder bed fusion (PBF-EB/LB), metallurgical lab preparation, microscopy, finite element modeling (FEM), metrology, or Python/MATLAB is advantageous but not required.

Project time
The project is intended for a master thesis (30 credits). The planned start is January 2027, or another date agreed with the selected student.

Further information
This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp).

For further information please contact: Emil Strandh, emil.strandh@swerim.se

Application
Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in English or Swedish. Latest date for application is 20th of November. You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means we can fill the position before the deadline.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer
description:

title: Senior Business Analyst-Sales Air Content

We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The role

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? As a Senior Business Analyst in our Sales Air Content team, you will act as a commercial powerhouse driving revenue and strategic growth across our global B2B partnerships. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, partner yield optimization, and commercial execution, you will turn complex market data into high-impact business decisions.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of our efforts to optimize how we source and distribute our flight content. Your primary focus will be to commercially ensure that the team continuously improves our deliveries towards our B2B partners. Your analytical skills and actionable insights will be crucial as you:

    Optimize content & distribution by ensuring we offer the world’s best and broadest range of flight options and collaborating with internal teams to distribute the right options with our partners.
    

    Drive commercial growth by identifying revenue opportunities aligned with both team goals and partner strategies.
    

    Solve strategic problems by using commercial data (conversion, margins, partner performance) to build practical business strategies and drive solutions.
    

    Lead proactive initiatives by taking high-impact commercial projects from strategic diagnosis all the way to implementation and rollout.
    

    Align cross-functional teams by collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, as well as external B2B partners.

Requirements

You’ll work on a core product that shapes the travel experience of millions of users worldwide, within a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry. We embrace forward-thinking tech, encouraging our teams to leverage AI tools to work smarter and drive innovation. You'll be part of a passionate team dedicated to excellence, playing a vital role in executing our flight content goals, influencing partner success, and growing in a supportive environment that values innovation.

If you're ready to elevate your career and make a real difference in the world of travel, apply now and become a vital part of our mission!

Benefits

With us you can enjoy:

    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.

As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Security Engineer, Core
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? Empathetic with the people you work with, proactive about the work itself, and creative about how you solve it. Your passion is squashing bug classes at scale and helping developers without blocking them

Role? As a Security Engineer, you will own application security work end to end: bug bounty triage, code scanning, vulnerability management, and incidents. AI agents are a big part of how we scale that work. You will use them every day and help build new ones.

Tech stack? Our marketplaces run on Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# and Go, and some teams even use Haskell. We run on AWS and GCP, and most apps deploy to Kubernetes. We build our agents with whichever models fit the job best

Location? Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, or Aarhus office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA and Bilbasen. Around 500 developers deploy code to production several thousand times a week.

Why us? Most security teams are still deciding what to do with LLMs. We have spent a year running agents on production security work and measuring what actually helps. You will join while we are still working out the methods, and help shape them.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Security Experience: You have found and fixed vulnerabilities in real applications. You are comfortable in code you did not write, and can tell an impactful finding from noise.
    Engineering Background: You have shipped code to production. You would rather build the thing that prevents a bug class, or the agent that finds it, than write the report about it.
    Hands-on with AI: You already use LLMs in your daily work and want to push them further, by giving agents tools, context and harder problems. Experience building agents is a plus, but not required.
    Fast Learner: You pick up new, complex topics quickly. In this field, what worked six months ago might not be the best approach today.
    English Fluency: You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland.
    Education: A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. We value different paths into security.

WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work

We used to automate with code. Now we automate with reasoning. Security scanners find patterns, but confirming a real risk takes investigation: tracing a request across services, finding who owns them, checking how they are exposed, reading logs, and testing whether an attack works. We are teaching agents to do more of that investigation, so you can spend your time on the findings that matter.

The Product Security Team

We are seven people spread across the Nordics, and we meet up regularly to work together. We are part of the Delivery Platforms area in Vend. Core Delivery Platforms helps Vend create real value by turning delivery into a trusted, measurable flow. We build composable, self-serve platform capabilities and provide services that reduce friction and power the flow that connects build, data, and AI, so ideas become outcomes faster.If you want to learn more about Emil and the team, you can follow this Link here: vend.com/news/inside-vends-product-security-team-a-year-of-ai-agents-on-our-production-systems

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role

Autocom is undergoing a major technological transformation, with our entire product portfolio gradually moving to the cloud. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be part of our Cloud Enablement Team, responsible for the shared infrastructure and technical building blocks that enable our development teams to build, deploy and operate their services efficiently.

Our development teams are responsible for their own services and databases, while you and the Cloud Enablement Team provide the underlying platform, network and tools they need to work effectively. You will work with modern cloud technologies in AWS and play an important role in building the foundation for the next generation of our products, with a strong focus on security, scalability, automation and a great developer experience.

The role includes:

    

Developing and managing scalable and reliable AWS cloud infrastructure, including networking, load balancing and service mesh.

    

Automating and standardizing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), while developing CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure.

    

Building self-service solutions and reusable modules to enable efficient DevOps practices across development teams.

    

Managing observability, monitoring and security, including platform modernization and TISAX-related controls.

    

Troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and driving improvements in scalability, stability, performance and cost efficiency.

You will also have the opportunity to influence the future direction of our cloud platform and work with technology supporting a broad product portfolio, including Windows, iOS and Android solutions, as well as hardware that communicates with the cloud.

#LI-DNI

Your profile

We are looking for someone with:

    

A university degree in engineering, IT, computer science or a related field.

    

Experience working in a larger cloud environment, such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

    

Comfortable working in Linux environments

    

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

    

Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

    

A good understanding of networking, cloud infrastructure and how different services communicate with each other.

    

Experience with CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.

You don't need to have many years of experience to be successful in this role - we are also open to more junior profiles with a strong technical foundation, relevant experience and, most importantly, a genuine drive to learn and develop. You enjoy taking ownership, solving technical challenges and understanding how different parts of a technical platform fit together. You are curious about new technologies and motivated by the opportunity to help build something that is continuously evolving.

Application

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

title: Master thesis - Structural Analysis
description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable society.

Job Description

AFRY Technical Analysis is the largest consulting CAE-department in Sweden, with extensive experience within structural and fluid mechanics from a wide range of clients in several industries. We are deeply involved in many interesting projects, both national and international, and provide our clients with market leading CAE-competence.

This master thesis will be a collaboration between AFRY and AFRY´s clients within automotive, defense or energy-industry. The student will develop new methodology, with respect to structural analysis and FEA, to facilitate more efficient product development for AFRY´s clients. The results can pave the way for new modelling guidelines (often calibrated against test data), a more efficient way of working and increased simulations accuracy.

FEA tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS and LS-Dyna will be used with MATLAB and Phyton as a complement for post-processing and automatization. Analytical calculations are performed mainly to verify the analysis models and results.

Qualifications

You are specialized in solid mechanics and have good theoretical knowledge in general. You have a clear grasp of the basics with respect to strength, fatigue and dynamic analysis, and have performed some finite element analysis during your education. You have used commercial software before and are familiar with the basic FEA-approach, with respect to pre-processing, analysis, and post-processing.

As a person you are meticulous, ambitious, curios and eager to learn. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you appreciate the value added by working together with your colleagues to find the best solution. Lastly, you also have good communicative skills, both oral and in writing, and can explain complex issues in a comprehensible manner.

Additional Information

AFRY will most likely offer you a position as a CAE-Engineer after a successful completion of this master thesis.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.

Responsibilities

Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering

    Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
    Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
    Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
    Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.

Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation

    Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
    Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
    Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
    Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
    Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.

Feasibility & Technical Discovery

    Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
    Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.

Handoff & Platform Stakeholder

    Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
    Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
    Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.

Requirements

Must Have

    3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
    Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
    Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
    Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
    Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
    Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.

Nice to Have

    Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
    Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
    Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
    Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).

Benefits

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.
    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
At Lendo, we are on a mission to empower people to make smart, conscious financial decisions. We are entering an exciting growth phase, expanding our offerings to launch new products and help even more people navigate their financial journeys.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Product & Tech Sweden team, reporting directly to the Head of Product & Technology Sweden and joining the Product & Tech Leadership Team. In this role, you will lead and mentor our team of 3 UX designers and establish an elevated, user-first design culture across the company. You aren't just managing UI outputs you will champion service design, facilitate cross-departmental alignment, and shape holistic digital experiences that drive both user delight and business value.

About the role

As Lead Product Designer, you set the design vision and lead the end-to-end design practice across our ecosystem. You stay close to the daily design reality without micro-managing. You understand operational context, keep track of design deliverables, and step in to help your team navigate blockers, balance priorities, and refine their execution flow.

You combine empowering leadership with high standards for design craft. Whether coaching UX designers in deep problem framing, driving service design initiatives, or actively managing performance, you raise the bar for how design decisions are made across the company. You will be an integral part of the Product & Tech Leadership Team, working within a collaborative product-tech-design triad operating model.

Key Responsibilities

People, Leadership & Culture

    

Lead, mentor and coach a team of 3 UX designers, setting high standards for craft, feedback, and continuous learning.

    

Provide direction and clear guidance through regular feedback, development talks, and career progression planning.

    

Cultivate an inclusive, safe team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and craft excellence go hand in hand.

    

Manage performance, individual growth plans, and seniority adjustments in line with company frameworks.

Service Design & Cross-Functional Facilitation

    

Lead service design initiatives and facilitate cross-departmental discovery workshops to uncover root problems rather than build feature requests.

    

Partner closely with key non-design stakeholders (such as call agent managers and operations) to convert complex operational friction into intuitive software solutions.

    

Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders, and departments to resolve friction and align user needs with business value.

Design Strategy & System Leadership

    

Articulate the strategic value of a design system, leading its evolution, governance, and adoption to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across all digital touchpoints.

    

Champion user research and structured frameworks (such as the Double Diamond), compiling research into compelling narratives that articulate the "why" to secure organizational buy-in.

    

Collaborate within the Product-Tech-Design Leadership Team, partnering with Lead Product Managers and Engineering leads to align user needs with technical feasibility and business goals.

    

Explore and integrate modern workflows and AI-driven tools across design, prototyping, and front-end collaboration to accelerate discovery, iteration, and delivery.

About you

    

Experienced Design Leader: You bring at least 10 years of experience in digital product design, with at least 3 years of direct people management experience leading UX or Product Designers.

    

Master of Design Craft & Service Design: You have deep expertise in service design methodologies, end-to-end journey mapping, usability research, and modern frameworks like the Double Diamond.

    

Operational & Present: You stay close to the design flow, understand sprint dynamics, and support your team through both high performance and performance management needs.

    

Systemic & Strategic Thinker: You look beyond quick feature fixes to understand the broader ecosystem, articulating the strategic value of design systems and scalable user experiences.

    

Decisive & Compelling Communicator: You turn complexity into clarity, confidently navigating stakeholder discussions and inspiring teams through research-backed storytelling.

Ready to join us?

If you are a design leader who cares deeply about strategy, modern service design, and empowering high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

About the recruitment process

As part of our recruitment process, we may use psychometric testing through HI Assessments. We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.

We look forward to your application!

title: Professional Firmware Developer
description:
About the role

The Firmware Developer designs, builds and owns the firmware that runs on Kisi's access control hardware, from readers and controllers to video intercoms and wireless locks. Rather than shipping code and moving on, the role makes sure every device in our remotely managed worldwide fleet is secure, reliable and updatable, and that new products and features reach customers on quality.

Responsibilities

    Firmware development. Write and maintain robust firmware for current and future Kisi products on an industrial-strength embedded platform with built-in support for secure boot and OTA updates.
    Testing and fleet rollout. Define rigorous acceptance tests and, together with our QA engineers, supervise the rollout of new products and features to our global fleet of connected devices.
    Factory automation. Improve the efficiency of factory processes by automating flows such as quality assurance, device registration and labeling, so every device ships on quality.
    Security and reliability. Build firmware with security at its core, from secure boot and encrypted communication to safe OTA updates and recovery, so our devices can be trusted in the field.
    Platform selection. Take part in evaluating and selecting our next-generation IoT platform provider against strict security and business continuity requirements.
    Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with hardware, cloud, mobile and support teams to diagnose field issues, improve device performance and shape the product roadmap.
    Success looks like: Kisi devices around the world run secure, reliable firmware, updates ship smoothly, and new products reach customers on time and on quality.

Qualifications

    Strong proficiency in C for embedded systems
    Experience with microcontroller architectures (e.g. ARM Cortex-M) and peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I2C and UART
    Experience with real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS)
    Hands-on experience with embedded development tools such as J-Link, ST-Link, ARM-GCC and gdb, plus software tools like Git, Make/CMake and Python
    Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates and device security best practices
    Basic knowledge of assembly and Embedded Linux is a plus
    Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to own goals and see them through

title: Senior Business Analyst - PLM Digital Thread
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior PLM Business Analyst – Digital Thread & Product Data

📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

🏢 Work Model: On-site (0% remote)

💼 Role: Senior PLM Business Analyst – Digital Thread & Product Data

⭐ Seniority: Senior

📅 Assignment Period: 19 October 2026 – 19 October 2027

💼 Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role.

⏳ Availability: Immediately/On a short notice

About the Role

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong PLM/PDM expertise for a strategic consulting assignment in Gothenburg.

The assignment focuses on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Data Management (PDM), Digital Thread, product information, and component-related business capabilities.

You will work at the intersection of business processes, product information, technology, and digital transformation, helping organizations structure complex requirements, define future ways of working, and translate business needs into actionable solutions.

The role combines business analysis, process development, solution design, stakeholder management, and delivery support.

Key Responsibilities

    Conduct business analysis and capability assessments related to PLM and product information.
    Map current-state and future-state processes, information flows, capabilities, and user needs.
    Gather, analyze, structure, and document business requirements.
    Translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
    Work closely with architects, product managers, developers, and subject matter experts to detail solutions.
    Facilitate workshops, interviews, stakeholder discussions, and cross-functional alignment sessions.
    Develop process maps, solution concepts, business cases, and decision material.
    Support backlog management, prioritization, and roadmap development.
    Drive assigned initiatives from initial analysis through implementation support.
    Identify dependencies, risks, gaps, and decision points across business and technical functions.
    Contribute to change management, communication, and user adoption activities.
    Help improve the quality, traceability, governance, and reusability of product information across the product lifecycle.
    Support initiatives involving product structures, configurations, technical documentation, and engineering information.

Required Experience & Qualifications

    Extensive experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, PLM Business Analyst, or similar role.
    Strong hands-on knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM).
    Extensive understanding of PDM processes, information structures, logic, and system solutions.
    Experience working within complex product development and engineering environments.
    Proven ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and implementable solutions.
    Experience facilitating workshops and working with stakeholders across multiple functions.
    Strong understanding of business processes, information flows, and digital solutions.
    Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
    Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned activities through to completion.

Highly Desirable

    Experience with Digital Thread initiatives.
    Experience with product information management or master data initiatives.
    Experience managing product structures, configurations, technical documentation, and engineering information.
    Experience supporting digital transformation within product development organizations.
    Knowledge of PLM/PDM architecture, information models, and associated enterprise tool landscapes.
    Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar agile delivery tools.
    Experience working in large, complex industrial or engineering organizations.
    Experience with component sales, aftermarket, or product information initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

    Analytical, structured, and proactive.
    Comfortable working with complex business and technical environments.
    Able to quickly understand complex processes and information structures.
    Skilled at turning ambiguity into clear requirements and actionable activities.
    Comfortable communicating with both business stakeholders and technical specialists.
    Strong at facilitating discussions and creating alignment across different functions.
    Able to challenge assumptions constructively and drive work forward.
    Comfortable working independently while maintaining strong stakeholder collaboration.

Background Verification

Due to the nature of the assignment, background verification will be required before the selected consultant starts the assignment.

The required verification may include identity, right-to-work, address history, education, financial fitness, corporate directorships, criminal records where permitted by applicable legislation, and basic open-source/media checks.

Further information regarding the verification process will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Why Join Hykmann?

As a consultant with Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB, you will have the opportunity to work on strategic digital transformation initiatives within leading organizations in Sweden.

We work with experienced professionals across IT, engineering, digital transformation, business analysis, PLM, software development, and technology consulting.

title: Senior Kafka Platform Engineer  Integration & Cloud
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Kafka Platform Engineer – Integration & Cloud

📍 Location: Stockholm, Sweden

🏢 Work Model: 25% Remote

💼 Role: Senior Kafka Platform Engineer – Integration & Cloud

⭐ Seniority: Senior

📅 Assignment Period: 19 October 2026 – 30 September 2027

🕐 Workload: 100%

💼 Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role.

⏳ Availability: Immediately/On a short notice

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka Platform Engineer to join one of our consulting assignments in Stockholm.

You will be responsible for building, operating, securing, and continuously improving integration and messaging platform capabilities used by multiple development teams.

The role has a strong focus on Apache Kafka, Strimzi, Kubernetes, HiveMQ, automation, observability, security, and platform operations. You will work with a “you build it – you run it” approach, taking end-to-end responsibility for platform stability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

This is primarily a platform engineering and integration role, rather than a traditional application development position.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, deploy, operate, and maintain multi-cluster and multi-region Apache Kafka environments using Strimzi on Kubernetes.
    Manage enterprise HiveMQ MQTT broker environments.
    Plan and execute Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ upgrades and security patching with minimal or zero application downtime.
    Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connect Source/Sink connectors for integration between legacy systems and cloud environments.
    Design Kafka scaling strategies, node affinity, topology spread constraints, persistent storage, and resource allocation for high-volume workloads.
    Manage Kafka topics, partitions, compaction, retention, segments, and cluster resources.
    Design and maintain high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover.
    Manage Schema Registry and support Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema governance.
    Design secure ingress and traffic-routing solutions for messaging platforms.
    Implement Kafka ACLs, SASL authentication, OAuth/OIDC integrations, RBAC, SSL, and mTLS.
    Build and maintain observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit, and/or OpenTelemetry.
    Develop proactive monitoring and alerting for infrastructure and Kafka-related issues.
    Perform root-cause analysis for platform incidents and implement preventative measures.
    Provide advanced/Tier 3 support for issues including consumer lag, rebalance problems, storage issues, and network bottlenecks.
    Act as a technical SME for development teams using Java and Spring Boot, providing guidance on Kafka producer/consumer configurations and best practices.
    Develop reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, configuration, and deployment validation.
    Use ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to manage platform environments.
    Implement automated scaling solutions such as KEDA where appropriate.
    Build developer self-service capabilities for provisioning topics, schemas, credentials, and other platform resources within defined governance and security controls.
    Maintain clear technical documentation, READMEs, and operational guidelines.
    Take ownership of incident, problem, and change management at platform level.
    Collaborate with security, architecture, infrastructure, and development teams.

Required Skills & Experience

Kafka & Integration

    4–6 years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka at platform level.
    Strong experience with Strimzi and Kafka running on Kubernetes.
    Experience with Kafka Connect API and KRaft.
    Experience with HiveMQ or enterprise MQTT platforms.
    Strong understanding of Kafka cluster administration, performance, security, scalability, and troubleshooting.
    Experience with Schema Registry and Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema.

Cloud & Kubernetes

    Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
    Solid Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting experience.
    Experience with Linux environments, including WSL.
    Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud is beneficial.

Java & Application Integration

    4–6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.
    Understanding of Kafka integration patterns and Producer/Consumer configuration.
    Experience working with PostgreSQL.

DevOps & Automation

    Strong experience with CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
    Experience with ArgoCD.
    Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform or equivalent technologies.
    Experience with Helm and OCI-based artifacts.

Observability

    Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
    Knowledge of Splunk, Fluent Bit, and/or OpenTelemetry.
    Experience designing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational KPIs.

Nice to Have

    Experience with API Management platforms.
    Experience across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud.
    Cloud cost optimization experience.
    Experience working within large enterprise integration or platform organizations.
    Experience with advanced API security and OAuth/OIDC.
    Swedish language skills.

What We’re Looking For

    Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
    Comfortable taking end-to-end operational responsibility for production platforms.
    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with development, security, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
    Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
    A humble, collaborative, and continuous-improvement mindset.
    Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantage.

Why Join Us?

As a consultant with Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB, you will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging assignments within leading organizations in Sweden.

You will work with modern cloud, integration, messaging, Kubernetes, and DevOps technologies while contributing to platforms that support multiple development teams and business-critical workloads.

📩 Interested in this opportunity? Send us your updated CV

title: Material Technology Engineer – Comfort
description:
Company Description

Help create the next generation of comfort solutions

Are you passionate about textiles, comfort, and material innovation? Do you want to influence how millions of people experience comfort in their everyday life?

We're looking for a Material Technology Engineer - Comfort to drive the development of innovative materials, technologies, and manufacturing solutions within our Textile & Comfort area. You will combine deep material expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs, sustainability, and industrial production to create better products at an affordable price. Based on the responsibilities and competence requirements described for the Material Technology Engineer role.

Job Description

Your mission

As part of the Material & Engineering team, you will lead innovation and development projects focused on textiles, soft materials, comfort constructions, and related manufacturing technologies.

You will work closely with product developers, suppliers, innovation teams, and external partners to identify opportunities and transform ideas into scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Leading material and technology development projects within textile and comfort categories.
    Exploring new textile materials, fibers, constructions, fillings, foams, nonwovens, and comfort solutions.
    Evaluating emerging technologies and their potential application in future products.
    Supporting material roadmaps and identifying innovation opportunities that contribute to quality, sustainability, affordability, and customer value.
    Working early in the product development process to ensure optimal material and comfort solutions.
    Collaborating with suppliers, universities, startups, and industry experts to bring external innovation into the business.
    Developing and maintaining material specifications, quality requirements, and technical documentation.
    Driving knowledge sharing and capability building within Textile & Comfort.
    Supporting the implementation of new materials and technologies in industrial production.

Qualifications

Who you are

You are curious by nature and genuinely excited about understanding how materials influence comfort, functionality, durability, and sustainability.

We believe you have:

    A degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
    Experience working with textiles, soft materials, comfort products, upholstery, mattresses, bedding, furniture, automotive interiors, or related industries.
    Strong knowledge of textile materials, fiber technologies, fabric constructions, nonwovens, foams, fillings, or comfort systems.
    Experience leading development projects and working cross-functionally in complex environments.
    The ability to translate customer needs into material and technology solutions.
    A strong interest in sustainability, circularity, recycled materials, and future material innovations.
    Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
    Strong communication skills in English.

We think you'll thrive if you are

    Passionate about textiles and comfort.
    Curious about future materials and emerging technologies.
    Able to combine technical depth with commercial understanding.
    Analytical and comfortable working with both data and hands-on testing.
    Energised by collaboration across functions, cultures, and external networks.
    Motivated by creating products that improve everyday life for the many people.

Additional Information

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of comfort. You will work with material innovation from idea to implementation, influencing everything from next-generation textile materials to sustainable comfort solutions that reach customers around the world.

If you are excited about combining material science, textile expertise, innovation, and customer insight, we would love to hear from you.

Please see we will have this position open on several locations ( Älmhult, Warsaw, Shanghai and Ho Chi Minh City), it is however same position that we are looking for to be placed in one of these locations.

Apply now and help us create better comfort through better materials. Please send us your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English latest by 13 October 2026.

We wish for you to answer the following question:

    How do you see you could contribute as an MTE to the Textile and Comfort material innovation?

If you have questions about the role, please contact Material & Engineering Manager Catarina Englund at catarina.englund1@inter.ikea.com

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Femina Karlsson at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organizational changes provided competence requirements are met for the role.  

Welcome with your application!

title: ICEHOTEL - Chef
description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365 – a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

Join to our Breakfast and Lunch team, and create a memorable Swedish Arctic Breakfast experience to our guests through a buffet or a la carte service.

As a chef at ICEHOTEL, you’ll be part of a creative and dynamic team that delivers high-quality food experiences in a truly unique environment. We operate three distinct restaurants:

    The Restaurant – our main venue, open year-round, serving breakfast, lunch buffets, à la carte dinners, group menus, and special dietary requests. It’s also the hub for preparing over 3,000 meals for our tours and activities.

    The Old Homestead – our cozy winter bistro located in a 400-year-old wooden house by the Torne River, known for its signature pizzas and charcoal-grilled dishes.

    The Veranda – our chef’s table and show-cooking experience, where storytelling and creativity take center stage. Currently open during the winter season only.

Each restaurant has its own character, all rooted in the identity of Swedish Lapland.

Responsibilities

    Preparing and cooking our Breakfast, buffet or a la carte in a high quality, in line with ICEHOTEL’s culinary concept.

    Collaborate with the kitchen team to ensure smooth daily operations.

    Maintain high standards of hygiene, safety, and food quality.

    Contribute to menu development and seasonal offerings.

    Support events such as weddings, conferences, and private dining experiences.

Who are you?

We’re looking for a team player with a passion for food and a willingness to grow. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working with others to create memorable guest experiences.

Qualifications

    Previous experience in a professional kitchen is an advantage, but not a requirement – we value attitude and willingness to learn.

    Ability to work under pressure and adapt to seasonal changes.

    Good communication skills in English.

    A genuine interest in food, sustainability, and nature-based experiences.

About the position

    Type of employment: Full-time, part-time, or seasonal.

    Start date: As agreed.

    Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

    Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

    A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

    The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

    A supportive and inclusive team culture.

    Staff benefits and discounts.

    Accommodation options for employees.

Applications are only accepted through this application method. The position may be filled before the final application date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, feel free to contact diego@icehotel.com.

To be eligible for the position, you must be an EU citizen or have a valid work permit in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Our projects are never standard. Each turbine has its own history, configuration and operating conditions. The role requires strong leadership, sound engineering judgement and the ability to connect technical details with the overall project and customer need.

You will work closely with sales, project management, mechanical engineering disciplines and other key functions across Service. Drive Excellence

    Ensure technical and financial follow-up, manage interfaces and risks, and turn lessons learned into actionable improvements
    Act as first point of contact for new mechanical modification projects and coordinate priorities and workload with other engineering managers

Customer & Business Focus

    Experience of leading engineering projects and coordinating multiple technical interfaces
    Excellent communication skills, sound business judgement and the ability to build trust across teams and with customers

Your experience will be valued and amplified. As a manager in our team, you will join a leadership environment built on trust, collaboration and growth. You will have the mandate to develop both your team and how we execute mechanical modification projects across the Finspang gas turbine service fleet. Together with experienced colleagues and key partners across the business, you will help improve delivery performance, engineering quality and customer value.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. title: HV OR
description:
Role Overview

RLB is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Authorised Person to support the safe delivery, commissioning, energisation and operational readiness of complex electrical infrastructure on a major data centre project.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing HV and LV electrical safety activities, including isolations, switching, Permit to Work processes and Lockout/Tagout controls. The role will ensure that electrical works are planned and executed in accordance with project Electrical Safety Rules, approved procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Electrical safety and control

    Act as an appointed Senior Electrical Authorised Person for relevant HV and LV electrical systems.
    Manage electrical isolations, de-isolations, switching and energisation activities in accordance with approved Electrical Safety Rules.
    Prepare, review and approve isolation plans, switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.
    Issue, manage, suspend and close electrical safety documents, including HV Permits to Work, LV Permits to Work, Sanctions for Test and Limitations of Access.
    Implement and maintain effective Lockout/Tagout processes for electrical and hazardous energy systems.
    Confirm that safe working conditions have been established before authorising work or testing activities.
    Stop, suspend or reject work where electrical safety requirements, documentation or site conditions are inadequate.
    Maintain accurate records of electrical isolations, permits, switching activities and safety-document status.

Construction and commissioning

    Support the safe installation, testing, commissioning and first energisation of HV and LV systems.
    Coordinate electrical activities across construction, commissioning, operations, client, vendor and contractor teams.
    Review commissioning plans, energisation procedures, test documentation and operational-readiness requirements.
    Chair or contribute to electrical construction and commissioning coordination meetings.
    Monitor ongoing installation and commissioning works to make sure they remain aligned with approved programmes, procedures and switching schedules.
    Support the controlled handover of electrical systems from construction through commissioning and into operations.
    Provide technical support during fault finding, testing and the resolution of electrical-system issues.

Documentation and technical assurance

    Review and approve electrical RAMS, work permits, insulation certificates, drawings, inspection and test plans and associated safety documentation.
    Ensure electrical works are completed in accordance with approved designs, technical specifications, relevant standards and project procedures.
    Review electrical installation quality and identify deficiencies, non-compliance or incomplete works.
    Work with design teams and site personnel to resolve design-related installation issues.
    Support technical reviews of proposed changes, deviations and electrical-system modifications.

Safety leadership and compliance

    Promote a strong electrical-safety culture across the project.
    Conduct electrical-safety inspections, audits and site walkdowns.
    Monitor compliance with hazardous-energy control, Permit to Work and Lockout/Tagout requirements.
    Identify electrical risks and ensure appropriate controls are implemented before activities proceed.
    Support EHS teams with safety meetings, toolbox talks, audits and incident-prevention activities.
    Investigate electrical-safety observations, incidents and near misses, supporting root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
    Escalate material risks, unsafe conditions and non-compliance promptly to the relevant project management.

Training and stakeholder coordination

    Provide guidance, coaching and technical support on Electrical Safety Rules and site procedures.
    Deliver or support Authorised Person, Competent Person, Permit to Work and Lockout/Tagout training.
    Assess the competence and understanding of personnel undertaking electrical activities.
    Build effective working relationships with client representatives, contractors, vendors, construction teams and commissioning teams.
    Provide concise reports on electrical-safety performance, audit findings, emerging risks and the status of corrective actions.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications and knowledge

    Degree, diploma or recognised technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, electrical power systems or a related discipline.
    Formal training and appointment experience as an Electrical Authorised Person or Senior Authorised Person.
    Strong knowledge of HV and LV electrical distribution systems.
    Thorough understanding of Electrical Safety Rules, Permit to Work and hazardous-energy control.
    Knowledge of switching, energisation, testing, commissioning and operational-handover activities.
    Understanding of electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, switching schedules and isolation plans.
    Knowledge of applicable electrical standards, construction safety requirements and industry good practice.
    Health and safety qualifications such as IOSH, NEBOSH or an equivalent would be advantageous.

Experience

    Significant experience working with HV and LV electrical systems in complex construction, commissioning or operational environments.
    Experience supporting large-scale data centres, industrial facilities, power generation, nuclear facilities or other mission-critical projects.
    Demonstrable experience managing electrical isolations, switching programmes and Permit to Work processes.
    Experience reviewing and approving RAMS, insulation certificates, electrical drawings and commissioning documentation.
    Experience supporting the first energisation and commissioning of critical electrical infrastructure.
    Experience conducting electrical-safety inspections and compliance audits.
    Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, commissioning teams and client stakeholders.
    Experience delivering electrical-safety or Competent Person training.
    Experience with simultaneous operations and the coordination of overlapping construction and commissioning activities.
