Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at a regulated fintech institution
================================================================

**About Us**

We are a Zurich\-based, FINMA\-regulated financial institution operating at the intersection of traditional banking, payments, embedded finance and blockchain technology.

We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on banking executive to serve as Chief Executive Officer (CEO), with a strong track record in the Swiss or European banking sector and substantial experience in Financial Institutions (FI), Global Corporate Banking and/or High\-Net\-Worth Individuals (HNWI).

The successful candidate should combine solid banking experience, strong commercial and relationship\-management capabilities, and a deep understanding of operating a regulated financial institution.

**Your Role**

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the day\-to\-day management and sound operation of the Company.

You will lead and coordinate the Company’s key functions, ensure that its organisation and control framework meet the standards expected of a regulated financial institution, and work closely with the Board of Directors on the Company’s strategy and development.

A key part of the role will be to strengthen the Company’s position within the Swiss and international banking ecosystem, including relationships with banks, financial institutions, corporate clients and other key stakeholders.

You will also act as a principal representative of the Company towards FINMA, banking partners, clients and the broader financial community.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Overall Management \& Banking Operations:** Lead the day\-to\-day operations of the Company and assume overall executive responsibility for running a regulated financial institution. Coordinate key functions including Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology and Business Development. Ensure that the Company’s organisation, processes, controls and resources are appropriate for its business activities and regulatory obligations. Implement the strategy and priorities agreed with the Board of Directors.
* **Financial Institutions \& Banking Relationships:** Develop and maintain senior\-level relationships with Swiss and international banks, correspondent banks and other financial institutions. Manage and expand relationships with payment and financial infrastructure partners, including SWIFT, SEPA\-related institutions, card organisations and other banking service providers. Represent the Company in discussions and negotiations with banking partners and financial institutions. Support the development of the Company’s international banking network and institutional partnerships.
* **Corporate \& Institutional Client Development:** Contribute banking expertise to the development of the Company’s corporate and institutional client business. Bring a strong understanding of client needs across payments, transaction banking, cash management, treasury, foreign exchange (FX), liquidity management and cross\-border financial services. Contribute relevant treasury and FX expertise, including liquidity management, currency exposure, FX execution and related risk management. Ensure that commercial development remains consistent with the Company’s risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
* **Governance, Risk \& Compliance:** Ensure effective governance, risk management and internal controls across the Company. Work closely with Compliance and Risk to ensure compliance with Swiss regulatory requirements, AML/KYC standards and internal policies. Ensure timely remediation of regulatory and audit findings and appropriate follow\-up by management. Promote a strong risk and compliance culture throughout the organisation.
* **FINMA, Audit \& Regulatory Reporting:** Maintain a professional and constructive relationship with FINMA and other relevant authorities. Actively participate in financial and regulatory/compliance audits and maintain effective relationships with external accurate and timely regulatory, financial, tax and corporate reporting to FINMA, the Board of Directors, auditors and other relevant stakeholders.
* **Swiss \& International Financial Ecosystem:** Represent the Company within the Swiss banking and financial community. Maintain relationships with banks, industry associations, financial organisations and relevant working groups. Strengthen the Company’s connectivity with the broader Swiss and international financial sector.


**Candidate Profile**

We are particularly interested in candidates who have built their careers within established banks or regulated financial institutions.

**Required Experience:**

* 10\+ years of professional experience with a Swiss bank or major international bank, including substantial senior management responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in at least one, and preferably more than one, of the following areas: Financial Institutions (FI) / Correspondent Banking; Global Corporate Banking / Transaction Banking; Private Banking / HNWI / Family Office.
* Strong network within the Swiss and/or international banking sector, including senior relationships with banks, financial institutions and corporate or private clients.
* Practical experience dealing with FINMA and a strong understanding of the Swiss banking and regulatory environment.
* Strong understanding of AML/KYC, Risk Management, Corporate Governance and internal control frameworks.
* Solid understanding of banking accounting, financial statements, management reporting and regulatory reporting.
* Experience working with financial and regulatory auditors.


**Leadership Profile:**

* Proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams within a regulated financial institution.
* Strong commercial judgment combined with a sound risk and compliance mindset.
* Strong relationship\-building and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Able to operate both strategically and hands\-on in a relatively lean organisation.
* Comfortable representing the Company at senior level with regulators, banks, clients, shareholders and other external stakeholders.


**Additional Experience:**

* Experience in payments, transaction banking, cross\-border banking or digital banking is highly desirable.
* Understanding of embedded finance and modern payment infrastructure is an advantage.
* Knowledge of blockchain, DLT, stablecoins and digital assets is beneficial but not a prerequisite.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and .
* Swiss work permit or citizenship required.


**What We Offer**

* A senior executive role with overall responsibility for a FINMA\-regulated Swiss financial institution.
* The opportunity to lead the Company through its next stage of organisational and business development.
* Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international banking ecosystem.
* A hands\-on environment with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.

title: Technical Operations Coordinator, Prototype & Sample Execution
description:
Ref 2582828 \| Date: 4 Oct 2026

![Focuslight Switzerland SA]( )

Focuslight Switzerland is one of the leading manufacturers of high\-end micro\-optics. We have more than 20 years of experience in the fields of optical design, micro manufacturing, and metrology. Our micro\-optical components meet the highest requirements for applications in photolithography, optical networks, medicine, and metrology. To allow us to integrate last generation technology faster we are looking for a





**Technical Operations Coordinator, Prototype \& Sample Execution**

The Technical Operations Coordinator, Prototype \& Sample Execution coordinates engineering and customer sample builds from release through shipment. The role is the operational interface between engineering, production, planning, quality, logistics, procurement and approved external suppliers, ensuring that prerequisites are available, progress is visible and execution risks are escalated promptly.  

The primary objective is to reduce preventable delays, improve execution quality through complete and unambiguous build inputs, provide clear status visibility, and offload operational coordination from Project Managers, Technical Project Leaders and Product Line Managers. Product design, process definition, technical release decisions and supplier qualification remain with the responsible technical and functional owners.



### **Job responsibilities**



**Sample Build Coordination**



* Coordinate engineering and customer sample builds from release through shipment.
* Maintain a live overview of build status, priorities, blockers, due dates and shipment readiness.
* Follow up daily with internal and external stakeholders to keep execution on schedule.
* Organise build\-readiness and status reviews when needed.
* Escalate delays, unclear ownership or missing prerequisites to the appropriate responsible person.


**Build Readiness and Work Order Management**



* Create, follow up and close engineering work orders for sample builds.
* Create and maintain BOMs and routings according to approved inputs from the responsible engineers.
* Confirm that drawings, specifications, materials, tooling, inspection requirements and process steps are available before execution starts.
* Communicate clear and complete expectations when triggering internal or external work, minimising iterative clarification.
* Maintain revision discipline and build traceability in the relevant systems.


**Material, Supplier and Logistics Coordination**



* Raise purchase requests and follow up orders required for engineering builds.
* Locate and coordinate the availability of raw materials, indirect materials, consumables and approved packaging.
* Follow up approved suppliers regarding processing slots, lead times, delivery dates and returns.
* Coordinate sample\-related shipments and required documentation with Planning and Logistics.
* Flag shortages, delivery risks and inefficient support processes early.


**Execution Monitoring and Communication**



* Follow the progress of builds through clean\-room, external processing, inspection, packaging and shipment steps.
* Maintain clear visibility of ownership, status, priorities and risks for all stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational responses to bottlenecks without taking ownership of technical decisions.
* Confirm that required inspection records and shipment documentation are available before dispatch.
* Record recurring reasons for delay and support practical improvements to tracking and coordination routines.






### **Job Requirements**



* Technical degree, technician diploma or equivalent qualification in semiconductor manufacturing or a related technical field.
* Fluent English and French, spoken and written.
* Comfortable using Excel and learning digital business tools
* Ideally 2–3 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, clean\-room operations, technical operations, production support or a comparable environment.
* Sufficient organisational experience to navigate a cross\-functional environment, identify responsibilities and follow up effectively.
* Experience with prototype, engineering\-sample or NPI activities is advantageous but not mandatory.






### **Knowledge and Skills**



* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.
* Ability to create and maintain BOMs and routings from approved technical inputs.
* Good organisation, prioritisation, communication and follow\-up skills.
* SAP, ERP or MES familiarity is advantageous; system troubleshooting is not part of the role.






### **Professional Qualities**



* Persistent and proactive in following up open actions.
* Detail\-oriented and structured while managing multiple builds in parallel.
* Comfortable working across engineering, manufacturing and support functions.
* Able to identify risks early, communicate them clearly and escalate to the correct owner.
* Service\-oriented mindset focused on enabling high\-quality execution.






**We offer**



* A dynamic and flexible work environment with focus on work\-life balance.
* A global and multicultural company culture.

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)
description:
Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)

Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland

About the Company:

We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.  
We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.  
As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.

Your Role:

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manage.  
You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.  

How You Will Contribute to Our Success:

•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives  
•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence)  
•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors  
•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M&A, private equity and fundraising  
•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking  

Requirements:

•    A university degree with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship  
•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors  
•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment  
•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analysis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence)  
•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leadership experience in Asia and the United Kingdom  
•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders  
•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions  
•    Languages: English and Russian  
•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role  

What We Offer
•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company  
•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development  
•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence)  
•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportuni-ties and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe  
•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem  
•    A professional, ethical and performance-oriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development  

Interested?

If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future of an entrepreneurial asset management company, we look forward to hearing from you.

Office Administrator
====================

**JOB DESCRIPTION – OFFICE ADMINISTRATOR**



**Location: Zürich**

**Division: Ticketmaster Central Europe Market, Switzerland**

**Manager: Managing Director, Switzerland**

**Contract Terms: 80\-100%, Full Time 42\.5 hours per week**



**THE JOB**


You are the organisational backbone of Ticketmaster Switzerland and run our office in Dübendorf to a high standard. You keep the market's administrative processes running, supporting Finance, HR and Customer Service, and you own our Experience Management, VIP guests, lounges, complimentary tickets and invitations.

In addition, you keep calendars, meetings and deadlines on track and provide administrative support to the Managing Director.




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**



Office Management



* Run the office to a high standard, supplies, mail, keys/keycards, parking and pool car, visitor welcome.
* Liaise with the landlord and external contractors, oversee facility topics and health \& safety.
* Maintain office policies, internal manuals and process documentation.
* Organise team events and maintain the team vacation and absence overview.




Team Support



* Support HR administration, on\-/offboarding, personnel files, coordination with insurance and payroll partners, in collaboration with the global HR Operations team.
* Support Finance with preparatory accounting, support in digitalising accounting processes, and payment follow\-ups.
* Contract and vendor management, deadlines, filing and coordination with external vendors.
* Maintain the weekly event outlook so all functions can plan ahead.
* Support the team with administrative tasks and cross\-department coordination.
* Ad\-hoc tasks and projects as required.




Experience Management



* Manage VIP guests, lounges and hospitality at concerts, festivals and sports events.
* Administer complimentary tickets, invitations and guest lists for clients and partners.
* Coordinate hospitality logistics with promoters and venues.
* Organise internal occasions (e.g. employee events and recognition).




Administrative Support \& Coordination



* Manage the Managing Director's calendar and inbox, prioritise and schedule with foresight.
* Prepare meetings, briefings and presentations (Management Team meetings, Town Halls), take minutes and manage follow\-ups.
* Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines and follow up proactively.
* Plan and book travel and handle expense reporting for the team and the Managing Director.
* First point of contact for internal and external requests, handling confidential matters with discretion.




**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**



* Experience as an office manager, executive assistant or in a comparable organisational role.
* Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, calm and structured under multiple demands.
* High discretion and reliability in handling confidential information.
* Advanced Outlook and MS Office skills.
* Fluent and English; French is a plus.
* Affinity for live entertainment and hosting, willingness to attend selected evening/weekend events.
* Proactive, hands\-on and service\-minded personality.




YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)



* You are a highly organised, proactive and dependable professional who enjoys being the trusted go\-to person in a fast\-moving environment.
* You anticipate needs, bring structure to complex priorities and follow through reliably, even when several stakeholders and deadlines compete for attention.
* You communicate with confidence, warmth and tact at all levels—from senior leadership and external partners to colleagues across the business.
* You handle confidential information with sound judgement, absolute discretion and a strong sense of ownership.
* You are service\-minded and naturally create positive experiences for colleagues, clients and VIP guests, with a genuine eye for detail.
* You remain calm, flexible and solutions\-oriented under pressure, especially around events and changing schedules.
* You enjoy working independently while being a collaborative, hands\-on team player who is happy to step in wherever support is needed.
* You take pride in creating an efficient, welcoming and well\-run office environment.
* You have an affinity for live entertainment and enjoy contributing to memorable experiences for fans, partners and the team.




LIFE AT TICKETMASTER



We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.



Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.



We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.



**Our work is guided by our values:**



**Reliability** \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.



**Teamwork** \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team



**Integrity** \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent



**Belonging** \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive



EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES



We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.



HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.



Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Im direkten Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einem renommierten, sympathischen Handels\- und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen mit Sitz im Herzen der Stadt Zürich (zentrale , zudem Teile Homeoffice gegeben), suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n



### der Arbeit



In der Funktion als HR Generalist/in übernehmen Sie in einem kleinen, sympathischen HR Team vielseitige Aufgaben für ca. 150 Mitarbeitende in allen operativen HR Themenfeldern und wirken auch in konzeptionellen/strategischen Themen/Projekten mit. Sie beraten/betreuen verschiedene Business Units in HR Fragen, sind in der HR Administration von tätig, und übernehmen Aufgaben in der Rekrutierung/Interviewführung. Auch die Mitarbeit in der Personalentwicklung sowie in diversen HR Projekten (z.B. Optimierung HRIS, C\&B etc.) gehört, wie auch die gemeinsame Vorbereitung der monatlichen Lohnläufe (Payroll bei externem Provider), zu Ihrem Tätigkeitsbereich. Als Teil eines sympathischen, dynamischen HR Teams sind Sie für Ihre Abteilungen/Linienvorgesetzten die kompetente HR\-Ansprechperson von A\-Z. Die Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung interner HR Prozesse macht Ihre Funktion zusätzlich spannend und abwechslungsreich. Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen die Mitarbeit in einem kollegialen Team in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfeld eines renommierten Unternehmens mit attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen.



### Anforderungsprofil



Um diese interessante Herausforderung optimal zu meistern, bringen Sie die Weiterbildung zur HR Fachfrau/Fachmann mit (denkbar ist auch eine Weiterbildung als HR Assistentin/Sachbearbeiterin kombiniert mit langjähriger relevanter Berufspraxis) und verfügen über vielseitige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen, generalistischen HR Funktion (z.B. HR Fachfrau, HR Generalist) inkl. Payroll\-Admin Praxis. Berufspraxis aus einer ähnlichen Branche (Finanzbranche, Treuhand, Immobilien etc.) ist von Vorteil, aber nicht Bedingung. Sie kommunizieren stilsicher in Deutsch sowie gut in Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil. Im Umgang mit den MS Office Anwendungen sind Sie versiert und durften bereits Praxis mit HRIS (ideal Abacus und/oder MS Dynamics) sammeln. Wenn Sie zudem eine offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit sind, die auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen bewahrt, sollten Sie sich baldmöglichst bei uns bewerben.  

Suchen Sie eine neue Herausforderung in einer vielseitigen HR Funktion in einem Team, welches den ´Team Spirit´ lebt und gemeinsam optimale HR Dienstleistungen im Unternehmen erbringt?
